  function pendingCornerText(state) {
    // Existing read-only evidence only. Stages are the furthest native check
    // reached for this request, not a diagnosis of the latest turn or failure.
    // A missing hit does not prove the road has no qualifying bends.
    if (state.cornerHits > 0) return 'Armed · waiting for current settings confirmation';
    if (state.cornerRouteOwned === true && state.cornerPlannerCorners === 0) return 'Armed · native plan currently has no corner entries';
    if (state.cornerProbeStage === 6) return 'Armed · limiting curve seen; reduction not confirmed';
    if (state.cornerProbeStage === 5) return 'Armed · planner reached; no speed reduction recorded';
    if (state.cornerProbeStage >= 1 && state.cornerProbeStage <= 4) return 'Armed · native corner checks not yet complete';
    return 'Armed · no native corner reduction recorded';
  }

  function hold(code, down) {
    if (down && !held.has(code)) { if (!physicallyHeld.has(code)) { held.add(code); key(code, true); } }
    else if (!down && held.delete(code) && !physicallyHeld.has(code)) key(code, false);
  }

  window.addEventListener('blur', () => { recordDiagnostic('pause',{reason:'blur',tools:diagnosticTools()}); physicallyHeld.clear(); suspend('Paused while unfocused. Enabled tools resume when you return to a supported driving mode.'); });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { recordDiagnostic(document.hidden?'pause':'resume',{reason:'hidden',hidden:document.hidden,tools:diagnosticTools()}); if (document.hidden) suspend('Paused while the tab is hidden. Your enabled choices are kept.'); });
  window.addEventListener('storage',event=>{
    if(!ToolProfiles||![null,ToolProfiles.KEY,ToolProfiles.STOP_KEY].includes(event.key))return;
    const after=profileStore.refresh();
    const changed=loadedProfile&&!after.data.profiles.some(p=>p.id===loadedProfile.id&&p.revision===loadedProfile.revision);
    if(event.key===null||event.key===ToolProfiles.STOP_KEY||!after.available||changed){
      stop('Profile storage or Stop changed in another tab. Current driving controls are off. Load a profile explicitly to resume.',false);
      profileSessionStopped=true;try{sessionStorage.setItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP,'1');}catch{}
    }
    profileSelection=null;profileNotice=after.error||'Profiles updated in another tab. Select a profile again; nothing was automatically loaded.';renderProfiles();
  });
  window.addEventListener('pageshow',event=>{
    if(!event.persisted)return;
    // A BFCache page must recheck durable Stop and profile permissions before it
    // resumes. Do not auto-reload a profile or revive a retained controller.
    stop('Page restored. Driving controls remain off; load a profile explicitly to resume.',false);
    profileStore?.refresh();profileSelection=null;profileNotice='Page restored with controls off. Select and Load a profile to resume.';renderProfiles();
    clearInterval(timer);timer=setInterval(tick,50);
  });
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { recordDiagnostic('page-hide',{reason:'page-hide',tools:diagnosticTools()});savePrefs(); suspend(); clearInterval(timer); });

  function setDrift(wanted) {
    if (driftPending) return false;
    const state = engine?.state(), counters = engine && statusPtr ? engine.status(statusPtr) : null;
    if (!supported || !state?.ready || !state.driving || state.network || !counters || (counters.drive & 3) !== 2 || !Number.isFinite(counters.drift) || document.hidden || document.querySelector('dialog[open]')) {
      message('Drift assist only works while driving solo free roam with the game menus closed.'); return false;
    }
    if (!!(counters.drift & 1) === wanted) return true;
    // Rebuilding the native drift setup must not inherit our power multiplier.
    engine.restorePerformance(state);engine.restoreGrip(state);powerGate.reset();gripGate.reset();
    if (!engine.driftTap(inputPtr)) { message('Drift request not sent: the game input mailbox is unavailable, inactive, typing, or full.'); return false; }
    driftPending = { wanted, until: performance.now() + 3000 };
    ui.querySelector('#drift').disabled = true;
    message('Drift request sent. Waiting for the game to confirm its handling state…');
    return true;
  }
  function moduleFailure() {
    const patch=AI?.patchState;
    if(moduleProfile || patch?.phase!=='unavailable')return '';
    const reported=/^[a-f0-9]{8,40}$/.test(revision)?` Site reports build ${revision}.`:'';
    const bytes=Number.isSafeInteger(patch.moduleBytes)?` Loaded module: ${patch.moduleBytes} bytes.`:'';
    const signatures=Number.isInteger(patch.signatureUnique)?` Fingerprints: ${patch.signatureUnique}/${patch.signatureTotal} unique matches; this does not approve an unknown build.`:'';
    return ['module-size','module-hash'].includes(patch.patchCode)
      ? `Game module is not verified.${reported}${bytes} A compatible Driving Tools update is required.${signatures}`
      : `Game module could not be prepared.${reported} Reload once. If it persists, export the diagnostic log.`;
  }
  function tick() {
    try {
      const patch=AI?.patchState,phase=patch?.phase || 'idle';
      const key=JSON.stringify([phase,patch?.revision,patch?.moduleBytes,patch?.moduleHash,patch?.patchCode,patch?.signatureReference,patch?.signatureUnique,patch?.signatureFailed,revision]);
      if(key!==diagnosticPatch){diagnosticPatch=key;recordDiagnostic('patch-state',{phase,revision:patch?.revision,reportedRevision:revision,candidateRevision:patch?.candidateRevision,moduleBytes:patch?.moduleBytes,moduleHash:patch?.moduleHash,patchCode:patch?.patchCode,signatureReference:patch?.signatureReference,signatureExact:patch?.signatureExact,signatureTotal:patch?.signatureTotal,signatureUnique:patch?.signatureUnique,signatureMissing:patch?.signatureMissing,signatureAmbiguous:patch?.signatureAmbiguous,signatureFailed:patch?.signatureFailed,error:phase==='unavailable'?patch?.reason:undefined});}
      if(ui){const status=diagnostics?.status();ui.querySelector('#diagnostic-state').textContent=status?`${status.events} recent events · ${status.persistence==='same-tab'?'kept across reloads in this tab':'memory only; storage unavailable'}`:'Logger unavailable';if(status&&Number.isInteger(patch?.signatureUnique))ui.querySelector('#diagnostic-state').textContent+=` · fingerprints ${patch.signatureUnique}/${patch.signatureTotal}`;}
    } catch {}
    updateDynoUI();
    if(dyno?.busy) {clearApplicationEvidence('tuner-busy');clearInfoHud('Tuner busy · driving tools paused');try{diagnostics?.snapshot({...diagnosticState,dynoBusy:true,tools:diagnosticTools()});}catch{} wall?.stop();cars?.stop();ai?.stop();release();return;}
    if (!engine) { clearApplicationEvidence('not-ready');if (live) live.textContent = 'Waiting for game. Reload after installing, then press Play.'; return; }
    try {
      const s = engine.state(), counters = statusPtr ? engine.status(statusPtr) : null;
      dragRace=!!(s.ready && s.drag);
      const driveStatus = counters && Number.isFinite(counters.drive) ? counters.drive & 3 : 0;
      const canInput = supported && s.ready && (!s.network || prefs.online) && driveStatus !== 0 && !document.hidden && document.hasFocus() && !document.querySelector('dialog[open]');
      const safe = canInput && s.driving;
      // Record identity changes as booleans, never addresses or save/player identifiers.
      try {
      const identity={player:engine.u32(0xd00000),car:s.car,race:s.race};
      diagnosticState={generation:sessionGeneration,revision,supported,ready:!!s.ready,driving:!!s.driving,network:!!s.network,safe:!!safe,hidden:document.hidden,focused:document.hasFocus(),hud:driveStatus,flow:engine.u32(0x8654a4),gameTicks:engine.u32(0x86518c),raceType:engine.u32(0x89e7b0),racePhase:s.ready?engine.u32(s.race):0,driverKind:s.ready?engine.u32(s.car+0x24):0,physicsKind:s.ready?engine.u32(s.car+0x28):0,dynoBusy:!!dyno?.busy,tools:diagnosticTools()};
      if(diagnosticIdentity && Object.keys(identity).some(key=>identity[key]!==diagnosticIdentity[key]))recordDiagnostic('identity-change',{playerChanged:identity.player!==diagnosticIdentity.player,carChanged:identity.car!==diagnosticIdentity.car,raceChanged:identity.race!==diagnosticIdentity.race});
      diagnosticIdentity=identity;
      } catch {}
      const nativeRaceType=s.ready?engine.u32(0x89e7b0):null;
      const roamProfile=!dragRace && driveStatus===2 && nativeRaceType===0;
      const raceProfile=!dragRace && (nativeRaceType===1 || nativeRaceType===7);
      const roadRaceProfile=(!s.network || prefs.online) && !dragRace && driveStatus===1 && nativeRaceType===1 && !engine.u8(0x89e7d8) && !engine.u8(0x89e7d9) && !engine.u32(0x890108) && !engine.u32(0x890104) && !engine.u32(0x890114);
      const nativeDriftPace=moduleProfile?.capabilities.nativeDriftPace===true && !dragRace && !engine.u32(0x890108) && !!(engine.u8(0x89e7d9)||engine.u32(0x890104)||engine.u32(0x890114));
      const requestedPace=nativeDriftPace?1:roamProfile && prefs.aiPace?prefs.paceFactor:raceProfile && prefs.racePace?prefs.racePaceFactor:1;
      // Drop synthetic input before publishing a native drag handoff request.
      const dragAIRequested = prefs.ai && dragRace;
      if (dragAIRequested) release();
      const aiState = ai?.update({enabled:prefs.ai,safe,state:s,mode:driveStatus,pace:requestedPace,allowNetwork:prefs.online,allowDragAI:dragAIRequested,cornerAssist:prefs.cornerAssist,cornerFactor:prefs.cornerFactor,cornerMargin:prefs.cornerMargin,raceCornerAssist:prefs.raceCornerAssist && roadRaceProfile,raceCornerFactor:prefs.raceCornerFactor,raceCornerMargin:prefs.raceCornerMargin,raceBraking:prefs.raceBraking,dragNoBlowout:prefs.dragNoBlowout}) || {available:false,active:false,status:'Native game AI · experimental',reason:'Reload with the native AI module installed.'};
      const paceConfirmed=!!prefs.ai && safe && !ai?.handbackPending && !aiState.switching && !!aiState.active && Number.isFinite(aiState.paceApplied) && aiState.paceApplied>=.75 && aiState.paceApplied<=3;
      const wallState=wall?.update({enabled:prefs.walls,safe,state:s}) || {requested:false,hits:0,reason:'Reload with the wall-contact module installed.'};
      const carState=cars?.update({enabled:prefs.cars,onlineTraffic:prefs.traffic,onlinePlayers:prefs.players,allowNetwork:prefs.online,safe,state:s}) || {requested:false,hits:0,reason:'Car no-clip is not verified for this build.'};
      try {diagnosticState={...diagnosticState,...engine.nosDiagnostics(s,supported&&moduleProfile?.capabilities.driftDiagnostics===true)};} catch {}
      let nos = false;
      if (safe && prefs.nos) nos = engine.refill(s,prefs.online);
      let tune={active:false},grip={active:false};
      // Observational only: selection, page-side write success and a native
      // pace-hook acknowledgement are different from measured vehicle speed.
      let powerStatus=!(prefs.boost||prefs.unlimit)?'off':!supported?'unsupported':!s.ready?'not-ready':s.network&&!prefs.online?'network-permission':document.hidden?'hidden':!document.hasFocus()?'unfocused':!driveStatus?'hud':!s.driving?'not-driving':!safe?'menu':driftPending?'drift-change':'settling';
      if(safe && !driftPending && (prefs.boost || prefs.unlimit)) {
        const info=engine.performanceInfo(s),patch=engine.performancePatch;
        if(patch && (!info || patch.car!==s.car || patch.race!==s.race || patch.pi!==info.pi)) {engine.restorePerformance(s);powerGate.reset();}
        if(!info){powerGate.reset();powerStatus='layout';}
        if(info && (engine.performancePatch || powerGate.accept([s.car,s.race,info.pi,...info.values]))) {
          tune=engine.tunePerformance(s,prefs.boost?prefs.power:1,prefs.unlimit,prefs.online);
          powerStatus=tune.active?'applied':tune.ok?'neutral':tune.changed?'changed':'rejected';
          if(tune.changed){powerGate.reset();message(tune.reason);}
        }
      } else {engine.restorePerformance(s);powerGate.reset();}
      if(safe && !driftPending && prefs.grip) {
        const info=engine.gripInfo(s),patch=engine.gripPatch;
        if(patch && (!info || patch.car!==s.car || patch.race!==s.race || patch.physics!==info.physics || patch.wheels.some((w,i)=>w!==info.wheels[i]))) {engine.restoreGrip(s);gripGate.reset();}
        if(!info)gripGate.reset();
        if(info && (engine.gripPatch || gripGate.accept([s.car,s.race,info.physics,...info.wheels,...info.values]))) {
          grip=engine.tuneGrip(s,prefs.gripFactor,prefs.online);
          if(grip.changed){gripGate.reset();message(grip.reason);}
        }
      } else {engine.restoreGrip(s);gripGate.reset();}
      try {diagnosticState={...diagnosticState,...engine.nativeDiagnostics(s,supported&&moduleProfile?.capabilities.driftDiagnostics===true),...engine.dragEngineDiagnostics(s,supported&&moduleProfile?.capabilities.nativeDragOverheat===true),powerStatus,paceConfirmed,paceApplied:paceConfirmed?aiState.paceApplied:undefined,powerActive:!!tune.active,gripActive:!!grip.active,effectivePower:tune.power,effectiveGrip:grip.factor,limiterRemoved:!!tune.unlimit,aiActive:!!aiState.active,aiOwned:!!aiState.owned,handbackPending:!!ai?.handbackPending,pageHeartbeat:ai?.hb,nativeHeartbeatAck:aiState.ready&&typeof ai?.read==='function'?ai.read(44):undefined,aiRequestedMode:aiState.ready&&typeof ai?.read==='function'?ai.read(8):undefined,aiNativeStatus:aiState.ready&&typeof ai?.read==='function'?ai.read(52):undefined,aiStaleTicks:aiState.ready&&typeof ai?.read==='function'?ai.read(48):undefined,aiSkillSaved:aiState.ready&&typeof ai?.read==='function'?!!ai.read(64):undefined,savedNativeSkill:aiState.ready&&typeof ai?.read==='function'&&ai.read(64)?ai.read(68):undefined,requestedPace,cornerRequested:!!aiState.cornerRequested,cornerMemoryBlocked:!!aiState.cornerMemoryBlocked,cornerDriftBlocked:!!aiState.cornerDriftBlocked,cornerMode:aiState.cornerMode,cornerPace:aiState.cornerPace,cornerBraking:aiState.cornerBraking,brakingHits:aiState.brakingHits,cornerHits:aiState.cornerHits,cornerApplied:aiState.cornerApplied,cornerProbeStage:aiState.cornerProbeStage,cornerDriverValid:aiState.cornerDriverValid,cornerRouteOwned:aiState.cornerRouteOwned,cornerRouteNodes:aiState.cornerRouteNodes,cornerPlannerCorners:aiState.cornerPlannerCorners,cornerGuardMask:aiState.cornerGuardMask,wallRequested:!!wallState.requested,wallHits:wallState.hits,onlineTrafficRequested:!!carState.onlineTraffic,onlinePlayersRequested:!!carState.onlinePlayers,onlineRaceCarsRequested:!!carState.onlineRaceCars,trafficHits:carState.trafficHits,playerHits:carState.playerHits,carRequested:typeof carState!=='undefined'?!!carState.requested:false,carHits:typeof carState!=='undefined'?carState.hits:0};diagnostics?.snapshot(diagnosticState);} catch {}
      infoHudSample={at:performance.now(),data:{...diagnosticState},context:{menu:!!document.querySelector('dialog[open]'),drag:dragRace,drift:nativeDriftPace,roam:roamProfile,race:raceProfile,paceAvailable:moduleProfile?.capabilities.pace===true,aiAvailable:aiState.available,aiStatus:aiState.status,manual:aiState.manual,switching:!!aiState.switching}};

      const now = performance.now();

        if (s.driving && prefs.nos && nos && s.gear >= 3) hold('AltLeft', true); else hold('AltLeft', false);

        ui.querySelector('#enabled').textContent=enabled ? `${enabled} selected` : 'Ready';
        ui.querySelector('#cars-state').textContent=caps&&!caps.cars?'Not verified for this build':prefs.cars?(carState.soloReason||carState.reason):'OFF · other cars only · solo';

        if (prefs.tester && supported && s.ready && now - lastScan > 250) {

        const driftActive = driftKnown && !!(counters.drift & 2);
        if (driftPending && driftKnown && drift === driftPending.wanted && (!drift || driftActive)) {
          message(drift ? 'Drift assist ON: confirmed by the game’s handling state.' : 'Drift assist OFF: confirmed by the game.'); driftPending=null;

      }
    } catch (error) { recordDiagnostic('engine-error',{error,tools:diagnosticTools()});stop('Runtime changed or is unavailable. Reload the game before retrying.'); engine = null; }
  }
  function setPanel(open) {
    visible=!!open;
    if(host)host.style.width=visible?'244px':'170px';
    if(!visible && dyno?.busy)dyno.cancel();
    if(!ui) return;
    ui.querySelector('#tools-panel').hidden=!visible;
    ui.querySelector('#min').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(visible));
    ui.querySelector('#chevron').textContent=visible ? '▴' : '▾';
    renderInfoHud();
  }
  function updateDynoUI() {
    if(!ui)return;
    const busy=!!dyno?.busy,ready=!!(dynoEnabled && supported && dyno?.canUse() && !document.hidden && document.hasFocus());
    const context=ready&&!busy?dyno?.syncContext?.():null;
    if(context?.invalidated)dynoText='Car tuning or installed parts changed. Load settings or find a new tune for this game mode.';
    else if(context?.changed)dynoText=dyno.applied?'Applied tune found for this car and mode. Restore is available while it stays unchanged.':dyno.outcome?'Preview found for this car and mode. Review it before Apply.':'Ready for the selected mode. Load all settings or search a measured native estimate.';
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-mode').textContent=context?`Game tuning slot ${context.kind+1} of 5${Tune?.MODE_LABELS?.[context.kind]?' · '+Tune.MODE_LABELS[context.kind]:''} · selected in Mode Select`:busy&&dyno?.context?`Game tuning slot ${dyno.context.kind+1} of 5`:'Choose a race mode in the game, then open the Dyno main screen.';
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-find').disabled=!ready || busy || !!dyno?.applied;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-cancel').disabled=!busy;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-apply').disabled=!ready || busy || !(dyno?.full?dyno.outcome?.changed:dyno?.outcome?.improved) || !!dyno?.applied;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-restore').disabled=!ready || busy || !dyno?.applied;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').disabled=busy;
    for(const option of ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').options||[])if(['acceleration60','acceleration100','topSpeed'].includes(option.value))option.disabled=!dyno?.full;
    if(dyno && !dyno.full&&['acceleration60','acceleration100','topSpeed'].includes(ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value))ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value='peakPower';
    updateSetupEditor(ready,busy);
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-state').textContent=moduleFailure()?`Dyno unavailable. ${moduleFailure()}`:moduleProfile&&!moduleProfile.capabilities.dyno?'Not yet verified for this build':dynoText;
  }
  const tuneValue=value=>(value>100?'+':'')+(value-100);
  function updateSetupEditor(ready,busy){
    const editor=dyno?.editor,editable=!!(ready&&!busy&&editor&&!dyno?.applied);
    ui.querySelector('#tune-load').disabled=!ready||busy||!!dyno?.applied||!dyno?.full;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-preview').disabled=!editable;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-reset').disabled=!editable;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-group').disabled=!editable;
    const group=Tune?.GROUPS?.find(g=>g.id===ui.querySelector('#tune-group').value)||Tune?.GROUPS?.[0];
    for(let i=0;i<9;i++){
      const offset=group?.offsets[i],present=!!editor&&offset!==undefined,row=ui.querySelector('#tune-row-'+i),input=ui.querySelector('#tune-input-'+i);
      row.hidden=!present;input.disabled=!editable||!editor?.allowedOffsets.includes(offset);
      if(present){
        input.dataset.offset=String(offset);input.value=editor.draft[offset]-100;
        ui.querySelector('#tune-label-'+i).textContent=(Tune?.FIELD_LABELS?.[offset]||'Setting '+(offset+1))+(editor.allowedOffsets.includes(offset)?'':editor.unlockedOffsets?.includes(offset)?' · unverified':' · locked');
        ui.querySelector('#tune-value-'+i).textContent=tuneValue(editor.draft[offset]);
      }
    }
    const o=dyno?.outcome;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-changes').textContent=dyno?.full&&Array.isArray(o?.changes)?o.changes.map(x=>`${Tune?.FIELD_LABELS?.[x.offset]||x.field}: ${tuneValue(x.before)} → ${tuneValue(x.after)}${x.adjusted?' (native adjusted request '+tuneValue(x.requested)+')':''}`).join('\n')||'No accepted setup changes.':editor?'Edit sliders, then Preview changes. Drafts never alter the game.':'Load settings to see unlocked controls for this car and preset.';
  }
  async function runDyno(action) {
    if(!dynoEnabled || !dyno || dyno.busy)return;
    recordDiagnostic('dyno-action',{reason:action,tools:diagnosticTools()});
    suspend();
    dyno.setEnabled(true);
    try {
      if(action==='load'){
        await dyno.loadSetup();dynoText='All supported settings loaded. Edit a category, then Preview. Nothing changes in the game until Stage.';
      } else if(action==='preview'){
        const r=await dyno.preview();
        dynoText=`${r.changed?'Preview ready. Review accepted changes, then Stage selected preset.':'No accepted setup changes.'} Game unchanged. Native estimates: 0–60 ${r.bestResult.zeroTo60Seconds.toFixed(2)} s; 0–100 ${r.bestResult.zeroTo100Seconds.toFixed(2)} s; top ${(r.bestResult.topSpeedMps*3.6).toFixed(1)} km/h; ${r.bestResult.peakPowerKw.toFixed(1)} kW / ${r.bestResult.peakTorqueNm.toFixed(1)} Nm. NOS ${r.bestResult.nitrousSeconds.toFixed(2)} s / torque setting ${r.bestResult.nitrousTorque.toFixed(3)}. No handling/lap-time measurement.`;
      } else if(action==='find') {
        dynoText=dyno.full?'Searching in private memory · game setup stays unchanged':'Searching · original setup is restored after each trial';updateDynoUI();
        const r=await dyno.find({goal:ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value,onProgress:p=>{dynoText=`Searching ${p.evaluations}/${p.budget} trials · Cancel or F9 to stop`;updateDynoUI();}});
        const [field,unit]=({peakPower:['peakPowerKw','kW'],peakTorque:['peakTorqueNm','Nm'],acceleration60:['zeroTo60Seconds','s (0–60)'],acceleration100:['zeroTo100Seconds','s (0–100)'],topSpeed:['topSpeedMps','m/s']}[r.goal]);
        if(dyno.full){
          const manualSeed=r.seed?.some((value,index)=>value!==r.baseline[index]);
          const seedText=manualSeed&&r.changed?(r.improvedFromSeed?' Search improved the measured goal over your draft.':' No further measured improvement over the draft. Accepted manual draft retained.'):'';
          dynoText=`${r.baselineResult[field].toFixed(1)} → ${r.bestResult[field].toFixed(1)} ${unit} · ${r.evaluations} trials. Original kept. ${r.improved?'Measured goal improved versus original.':'No measured goal improvement versus original.'}${seedText} ${r.changed?'Review accepted changes, then Stage selected preset.':'No accepted setup changes.'} No handling/lap-time measurement.`;
        }else dynoText=`${r.baselineResult[field].toFixed(1)} → ${r.bestResult[field].toFixed(1)} ${unit} · ${r.evaluations} trials. Original kept. ${r.improved?'Stage preview to use this tune.':'No improvement found.'}`;
      } else if(action==='apply') {const r=await dyno.apply();dynoText=dyno.full?'Selected preset staged. Use the game’s Test Run to refresh driving physics, and Save Profile to persist. Disk save is not confirmed.'+(r.saveReady?'':' Other presets also have unsaved edits; native Save Profile saves them too.'):'Best tune applied. Use native Save Profile to persist.';}
      else {await dyno.restore();dynoText=dyno.full?'Previous current and selected-visit settings restored. Test Run refreshes physics. Save Profile again if you want this restored version persisted.':'Previous tune restored and confirmed.';}
    } catch(error) {recordDiagnostic('dyno-error',{error,dynoStatus:error?.dynoStatus,dynoGuard:error?.dynoGuard,dynoObserved:error?.dynoObserved,tools:diagnosticTools()});dynoText=error?.message || 'Dyno tuner stopped. Reload before retrying.';}
    updateDynoUI();
  }
  function exportDiagnostic() {
    if(!diagnostics){message('Diagnostic logger is unavailable. The game’s Download log may still have crash details.');return;}
    let url=null,link=null;
    try {
      recordDiagnostic('export',{tools:diagnosticTools()});
      const blob=new Blob([diagnostics.exportText()],{type:'application/json'});
      url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download='nfsu2-driving-tools-diagnostics.json';link.hidden=true;
      (document.body||document.documentElement).append(link);link.click();
      message('Diagnostic download requested. It stays local until you choose to share the file. For native crash details, also use the game’s Download log.');
    } catch(error) {recordDiagnostic('engine-error',{error});message('Diagnostic download failed. Try again, or use the game’s Download log.');}
    finally {link?.remove();if(url)setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);}
  }
  const profileToggleIds={raceCornerAssist:'race-corner-assist',cornerAssist:'corner-assist',racePace:'race-pace',walls:'walls',cars:'cars',traffic:'traffic',players:'players',online:'online',ai:'ai',aiPace:'ai-pace',nos:'nos',dragNoBlowout:'drag-no-blowout',drag:'drag',tester:'tester',boost:'boost',unlimit:'unlimit',grip:'grip'};
  const profileNumericBindings=[['race-corner-factor','raceCornerFactor','race-corner-value',2,'×'],['race-corner-margin','raceCornerMargin','race-corner-margin-value',0,'%'],['race-braking','raceBraking','race-braking-value',2,'×'],['race-pace-factor','racePaceFactor','race-pace-value',2,'×'],['corner-factor','cornerFactor','corner-value',2,'×'],['corner-margin','cornerMargin','corner-margin-value',0,'%'],['pace-factor','paceFactor','pace-value',2,'×'],['rpm','rpm','rpm-value',0,''],['power','power','power-value',1,'×'],['grip-factor','gripFactor','grip-value',1,'×']];
  function syncProfileControls(){
    if(!ui)return;
    for(const [key,id]of Object.entries(profileToggleIds))ui.querySelector('#'+id).checked=prefs[key];
    for(const [id,key,out,digits,suffix]of profileNumericBindings){const el=ui.querySelector('#'+id);el.value=prefs[key];ui.querySelector('#'+out).textContent=prefs[key].toFixed(digits)+suffix;el.setAttribute('aria-valuetext',prefs[key].toFixed(digits)+(suffix==='%'?' percent':suffix?' times':' RPM'));}
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-enable').checked=dynoEnabled;
    ui.querySelector('#drift').checked=!!prefs.drift;
    ui.querySelector('#hazards').hidden=!prefs.tester;
  }
  const profileLocks=()=>typeof navigator!=='undefined'&&navigator.locks&&typeof navigator.locks.request==='function'?navigator.locks:null;
  function renderProfiles(){
    if(!ui)return;
    const state=profileStore?.snapshot(),select=ui.querySelector('#profile-select');
    select.replaceChildren();const empty=document.createElement('option');empty.value='';empty.textContent='Choose a saved profile';select.append(empty);
    for(const p of state?.data.profiles||[]){const option=document.createElement('option');option.value=p.id;option.textContent=p.name;select.append(option);}
    const selected=state?.data.profiles.find(p=>p.id===profileSelection?.id&&p.revision===profileSelection?.revision);
    if(!selected){profileSelection=null;ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=false;}
    select.value=selected?.id||'';
    for(const id of ['profile-load','profile-update','profile-delete','profile-auto'])ui.querySelector('#'+id).disabled=profileActionPending||!state?.available||!selected||(id!=='profile-load'&&!profileLocks());
    ui.querySelector('#profile-save').disabled=profileActionPending||!state?.available||!profileLocks();
    for(const id of ['profile-select','profile-name','profile-network'])ui.querySelector('#'+id).disabled=profileActionPending;
    ui.querySelector('#profile-auto').checked=!!selected&&state.data.auto?.id===selected.id&&state.data.auto.stopToken===state.stopToken&&!profileSessionStopped;
    ui.querySelector('#profile-state').textContent=state?.error||(profileActionPending?'Waiting for another tab to finish saving profiles.':profileNotice)||(!profileLocks()?'Profile editing is unavailable because this browser cannot lock local saves.':!profileStore?'Profiles unavailable; existing controls still work.':state.paused?'Automatic loading paused by Stop. Select a profile and enable Load on startup to resume.':state.data.auto?'A saved profile will load on next startup.':'Automatic loading is off. Save current controls, then select and Load when needed.');
  }
  function selectProfile(){
    const id=ui.querySelector('#profile-select').value,state=profileStore?.refresh();
    profileSelection=state?.data.profiles.find(p=>p.id===id)||null;
    ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value=profileSelection?.name||'';
    ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=profileSelection?.networkConsent||false;
    profileNotice=profileSelection?'Selected '+profileSelection.name+'. Load applies its saved choices. Update replaces it with current controls.':'';renderProfiles();
  }
  function applyToolProfile(result,automatic=false){
    if(driftPending)throw Error('Wait for the current drift request to confirm or time out, then Load again. No profile was loaded.');
    if(dyno?.busy||dyno?.pending){dyno.cancel();throw Error('Tuner cancellation requested. Wait for the pending game request to finish, then Load again. A staged preset is not reverted.');}
    suspend();driftNeedsReapply=false;dragTakenOver=false;lastShift=0;lastPulse=0;
    const choices=result.settings;
    for(const key of Object.keys(prefs))prefs[key]=choices[key];
    dynoEnabled=choices.dynoEnabled;dyno?.setEnabled(dynoEnabled);
    if(ui){ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value=choices.dynoGoal;ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=result.profile.networkConsent;ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value=result.profile.name;}
    driftNeedsReapply=typeof prefs.drift==='boolean';profileDriftChoice=driftNeedsReapply;
    loadedProfile={id:result.profile.id,revision:result.profile.revision};savePrefs();syncProfileControls();
    dynoText=dynoEnabled?'Profile loaded. Open the solo Performance Tuning main screen. Existing staged presets are unchanged.':'Tuner off. Existing staged presets are unchanged.';updateDynoUI();
    profileNotice=(automatic?'Loaded on startup: ':'Loaded: ')+result.profile.name+'. Choices wait for verified game contexts.'+(result.profile.networkConsent?' Saved network permission restored where selected.':' Network permission and online no-clip remain off.')+' Game presets and drafts are not saved or restored by profiles.';
    message(profileNotice);renderProfiles();
  }
  function profileAction(action){
    if(profileActionPending)return;
    const request={stopToken:profileStore?.snapshot().stopToken,selection:profileSelection?{...profileSelection}:null,name:ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value,networkConsent:ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked===true,auto:ui.querySelector('#profile-auto').checked,settings:{...prefs,dynoEnabled,dynoGoal:ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value}};
    const epoch=profileActionEpoch;
    // localStorage has no atomic compare-and-swap. Serialize named-profile
    // writes across tabs with a browser-managed lock; Stop remains immediate
    // and its independent marker invalidates any stale startup authorization.
    const execute=()=>{
      if(epoch!==profileActionEpoch)return;
      if(action==='auto'){
        const latest=profileStore?.refresh();
        if(!latest?.available||latest.stopToken!==request.stopToken){profileNotice='Stop or profile storage changed while waiting. Select a profile and request startup loading again.';renderProfiles();return;}
      }
      performProfileAction(action,request);
    };
    if(action==='load'){execute();return;}
    const locks=profileLocks();
    if(!locks){profileNotice='Profile editing needs browser storage locking, which is unavailable. No profile was changed.';renderProfiles();return;}
    profileActionPending=true;renderProfiles();
    try{
      const result=locks.request('nfsu2-driving-tools-profiles-v1-write',execute);
      if(result&&typeof result.then==='function')result.catch(()=>{if(epoch===profileActionEpoch)profileNotice='Could not lock profile storage. No profile change was confirmed.';}).finally(()=>{if(epoch===profileActionEpoch){profileActionPending=false;renderProfiles();}});
      else {profileActionPending=false;renderProfiles();}
    }catch{profileActionPending=false;profileNotice='Could not lock profile storage. No profile change was confirmed.';renderProfiles();}
  }
  function performProfileAction(action,request){
    const selected=request.selection;
    try{
      if(!profileStore)throw Error('Profiles are unavailable.');
      if(action==='save'||action==='update'){
        if(action==='update'&&!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        const saved=profileStore.save({id:action==='update'?selected.id:null,revision:action==='update'?selected.revision:null,name:request.name,settings:request.settings,networkConsent:request.networkConsent});
        profileSelection=saved;profileNotice='Saved '+saved.name+' locally in this browser. This profile will not load on startup until explicitly enabled.';
      }else if(action==='load'){
        if(!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        applyToolProfile(profileStore.load(selected.id,selected.revision));return;
      }else if(action==='delete'){
        if(!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        profileStore.remove(selected.id,selected.revision);profileSelection=null;ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value='';ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=false;profileNotice='Saved profile deleted. Current controls are unchanged; automatic loading for it is off.';
      }else if(action==='auto'){
        const enabled=request.auto;
        if(enabled&&!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        profileStore.setAuto(enabled?selected.id:null,enabled?selected.revision:null);
        if(enabled){
          // Clear the fallback latch only AFTER the requested saved revision was
          // authorized successfully; a stale/failed enable must not erase Stop.
          try{sessionStorage.removeItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP);if(sessionStorage.getItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP)==='1')throw Error();}
          catch{try{profileStore.setAuto(null);}catch{}throw Error('Cannot clear the Stop pause in this tab. Automatic loading remains blocked here; check storage before retrying.');}
          profileSessionStopped=false;
        }
        profileNotice=enabled?'Load on startup enabled for '+selected.name+'. Its saved choices, including separately saved network permission, will be requested after reload. F9 pauses this.':'Automatic profile loading is off. Current controls are unchanged.';
      }
    }catch(error){profileNotice=error.message||'Profile action failed. Nothing was loaded.';message(profileNotice);}
    renderProfiles();
  }

- On exact 93af6ccb and 78e2bb69, Automatic driver integrates the reviewed native Drift yaw-damping path. One native player-curve expression selects the existing opponent curve only while ownership, permission, heartbeat, race state, native Drift driver/behavior/input aliases and full physics are valid.
- No model filter or new coefficient: the original car-specific coefficient and native sign/gear conditions remain. The intended difference is near/beyond the 89-degree curve knot. Goals, identity, scores, native opponent behavior, manual handling and global curve data are not edited.
- All three native Drift flags are recognized with drag precedence. Forced Drift still requires the valid owned Drift behavior and full-physics context. This is not an external driver or unrestricted free-roam assist.
- Adds bounded read-only Drift diagnostics to the existing local manual-export logger: native controller/action evidence, speed/target, track, scoring state, pending/banked points, raw rate, route progression and collision-loss latch. Corner hit/cap evidence remains separate from pace. No raw pointers, names, input or network traffic are exported.
- Native race AI and automatic switching, skill 9, drag action, native NOS decisions, dyno modes, adaptive corners, pace, solo collision switches, separate online NPC/player switches, power/grip/NOS controls and menu layout are preserved. The unfinished full tuner is not included.

## Verification and limits

Final combined suite: **1,472/1,472 tests passed, zero failures and zero skips**. Independent focused review: **157 cases passed**, plus native byte/local/section checks on both exact builds. Authored recovery/profile generators reproduce byte-for-byte and all JavaScript syntax checks pass. Fresh public metadata at **2026-11-09 19:23 UTC** still matches the exact 93af6ccb module.

Only one additional native body, function 8871, changes in either newest exact profile. Its original 17 locals are preserved; eight authored locals are appended. The only replaced native expression is the five-byte player-curve constant at offset 2471. Its inline replacement adds no stores or calls. All other native instructions, other bodies and non-code sections are preserved, except the eight existing v0.16 hook bodies. Both complete patched modules validate and compile.

The actual production-patched current body passes 156 native-opponent output comparisons, 45 fail-closed memory comparisons, 46 unchanged-native-opponent cases and six explicit eligibility cases. Native angle and rear-grip dependencies are controlled fixtures, not live physics simulation. Production bridge fixtures test acquisition, immediate stop, heartbeat expiry, stale ownership/physics/behavior and drag handback. Logger tests cover verified-profile gating, manual export, read-only memory invariance and removal of stale telemetry on mode exit.

No installed/live race, actual spin recovery, per-model handling, winning, score improvement or multiplayer synchronization is verified. The guard-installed status is not an observed recovery hit. Previously reported freezes, the page-thread tuning lifetime race and formal scratch-memory reservation remain unresolved. Keep v0.16 for rollback, back up progress, start with 1× pace and power/grip off, and test one feature at a time. F7 returns control and F9 stops tools.

# v0.15.0 · Native opponent AI paths

## Changes on exact build 78e2bb69 only

- **Opponent drag action:** allows the native initializer to select actual opponent “Win drag race” action 2 for the extension's requested and owned player car. It does not change racer identity, global difficulty, native action pointers or vtables directly. A confirmed player action 3 may be upgraded once through the initializer; NULL initializes lazily and recovery 11/other actions are left to the game. Status confirms id and vtable; pending is not success.
- **Native drift physics:** corrects normal unmarked player drift events to driver 3/physics 1 through the native setter, preserving drag-first mode precedence. Invalid driver state or failed correction rolls back to manual control. Existing mode/identity/heartbeat/network guards and full event handback remain.
- **Native nitrous decisions:** permits the owned player to reach native request/cancellation logic for recognized drag goal 2, observed road goal 1 in actual race types 1/7, and observed chase goal 5 only in Outrun 7. It never selects chase goal 5 or enables this new path in free roam 0. Native tactical/skill/availability/resource conditions remain intact; no refill or forced activation is added. The separate Unlimited NOS control remains unchanged.
- Cancellation uses the same authorized owned race scope without a new-start goal requirement, so recovery/NULL goal transitions cannot suppress native cancellation. New starts remain strictly goal-gated.

## Limits

**Force-only drag and the special 1099 combination are unsupported by the new opponent path.** It requires the actual native drag flag. This is not full opponent equivalence, a distinct specialist AI for every race, or a fastest-driver claim. No live race benchmark, reliable launch/shift/lane behavior, race completion, winning or crash-freedom is proven. Temporary/recovery actions are not forced. Native full allocator/configuration and cancellation execution, plus the complete skill/resource graph, remain unverified.

The reported freezes remain unresolved. Back up the save, preserve v0.14, enable only one extension version and reload the game. Begin with normal 1× pace and unrelated power/grip changes off. F7 returns control. Unknown game binaries stay disabled, and older exact supported profiles retain their previous behavior.

## Preserved v0.14 features

Guarded five-slot dyno Find/Apply/Restore and Store/Save guidance; adaptive free-roam corner margin and honest hit/status logging; separate online NPC traffic no-clip; solo collision switches; separate free-roam/race pace; NOS refill, power, limiter, grip, manual drag, drift input, read-only tester, signature scanner and sanitized local crash-log export are retained. Corner assistance remains free-roam-only and drag bypasses custom pace. No game assets, extracted binaries or research files are included.

## Verification

The final v0.15 release-folder suite passed **897/897 tests, zero failures and zero skips** after integration and version changes. Independent review passed **390 selected overlapping tests** on the frozen implementation. Authored drag-selector, owned-NOS and latest-profile builders reproduce byte-for-byte; all extension JavaScript passes syntax checks. Production JavaScript matches the frozen reviewed candidate except version labels. Additional bounded native downstream proof passed 56 cases with controlled skill/resource boundaries. These are not live gameplay or full end-to-end native graph benchmarks.

Only eight intended current-build bodies change: 3174, 4653, 7395, 17404, 19277, 21213, 21263 and 22470. All other function bodies and non-code sections remain identical. Older exact profiles retain their existing hooks. Strict-CSP browser visuals remain unverified because Chromium startup was blocked in this environment.

# NFSU2 Driving Tools: experimental v0.32.0

Unpacked Chrome / Edge / Brave extension for https://nfsu2.xyz/. See `CHANGELOG.md` for this release's changes and verification limits.

## v0.32.0: Race-only automatic driver

In **AI driver**, enable **Race-only automatic driver** to arm the native driver for races you start or join yourself. It waits for the active race/GO state, includes Street X, Drag and Drift, and requests handback in free roam, outrun, results or other ineligible contexts. It does not find, join, start, replay or vote for events.

The existing **Automatic driver** still includes free roam. Selecting either driver mode turns the other off. The race-only switch is **off by default**, stays armed between races on this page, and resets on page reload or profile Load. It is deliberately not added to saved profiles; existing saved choices and storage remain unchanged.

**F7, F9/Stop, or driving-key takeover during a race disarms race-only AI.** Manual steering in free roam leaves it armed. If driving controls are still physically held when entering a race, acquisition waits until they are released. Turning the switch off requests native handback. A genuine native manual request, finished/totaled state, failed-control latch or watchdog is not forced back to AI.

Online races still need the existing **Allow network tools** permission. Exact build, current ownership, race, focus/menu, native driver and handback guards are retained. A selected switch is not proof of active ownership; the HUD and local log show the effective request and native observations separately.

Optional **Adaptive road-race speed** is also included below. It remains off by default and leaves Street X unchanged. Neither option changes steering, shifting, NOS, game saves or native AI code. Live race efficacy and browser appearance remain unverified.

**Verification:** the complete combined release passes **1,907 automated tests, zero failures/skips/cancellations**, including race-only eligibility/lifecycle, optional adaptive mode, joint Street X/online/stop behavior and all retained features. Independent tests additionally cover production native handback and cached-route reconstruction. All four supported patched game module outputs remain byte-identical to v0.31.

For an existing installation, replace matching files in the already loaded extension folder, click **Reload** on that extension's browser card, then refresh the game. Verify **0.32.0**. Do not remove/re-add the extension or create a different folder just for this update.

## Optional adaptive road-race speed

A new **default-off, session-only** option coordinates the existing native route planner. Its separate straight-target ceiling defaults to **1.30×** and ranges from 1.00× to 2.00×. The native route uses distance to known corners to lower its target in advance while retaining a higher target on sufficiently long straights. This is a planned target factor, not a physical speed cap or a measured speed increase.

Enable either **Race-only automatic driver** or **Automatic driver**, then **Adaptive road-race speed** in AI driver → Road-race settings. Online use also requires **Allow network tools**. Adaptive mode uses the existing Race corner speed, Race sharp-turn margin and Race braking factor values, even when the separate Road-race hairpin assist switch is off. Lower braking factor requests earlier braking. It overrides the effective custom race pace only in eligible ordinary road races, without changing any saved switch or slider.

**Street X keeps the exact existing pace, corner and braking selections.** Adaptive mode is dormant in actual/forced Street X and the known online Street X mode. Drag, Drift/forced variants, Outrun and free roam are also excluded. Selecting adaptive mode does not turn on Automatic driver or network permission.

The optional ceiling stays constant while driving. The existing native route envelope varies by distance; JavaScript does not switch pace or reconstruct the driver at every corner. A deliberate setting or race-mode change may still require the existing OFF/acknowledgement/ON route reconstruction. Manual takeover, race end, permission withdrawal and the existing watchdog remain in force.

F7/manual driving keys stop AI and leave the optional selection dormant. F9/Stop, profile Load and page reload turn adaptive mode off. It is not added to saved tool profiles or legacy session preferences. Blur, hidden page and menus pause it normally. Turn it off to return to the prior controls after native handoff.

The HUD and local log distinguish a request, matching native pace acknowledgement, and observed corner/braking hook evidence. These counters do not measure braking success, safe corner entry or a clean lap. There is no new steering, obstacle avoidance, NOS control, added route horizon, opponent manipulation or collision protection. Higher targets can still cause crashes. Start at 1.30× and assess one change at a time.

Only page orchestration, a pure selector and bounded diagnostics change. Native hooks, the AI controller, engine tuning, NOS clock correction, Drag-retention fix, tuner and saved-profile implementation remain byte-for-byte unchanged from v0.31. Exact-native synthetic tests support the route-speed envelope; live racing, lap times, wins and browser layout remain unverified.

## Retained v0.31.0: Keep owned Drag AI through settings refreshes

A reproduced publication race could let the game's manual-Drag selector run while the extension refreshed the same active settings. The new guard retains an **already-owned, currently permitted native Drag AI lease** through that brief write. It does not acquire new control, force a real manual request back to AI, or change steering, shifting, NOS or damage.

A separate fix ensures a pause/end/OFF command is acknowledged by the native game before a quick restart can overwrite it. This also covers consecutive matches that reuse the same player, car and race objects. It does not clear the game's failed-control latch while AI remains continuously requested.

**F7/manual takeover, F9/OFF, native finish/totaled states, permission withdrawal, identity changes and the 180-native-frame watchdog remain effective.** Do not use this as a no-crash, no-damage or guaranteed-win feature. Online use still requires the existing explicit Allow network tools opt-in.

The fresh user log shows a request for manual Drag before the observed handback, matching the reproduced ordering. It does not record the rejecting guard, so this is not proof of that run's exact cause. The log came from v0.28. Live handoff prevention remains unverified.

Only the Drag input guard changes in the two supported modern native profiles. The HUD, tuner/static-ride fix, NOS clock correction, working Street X behavior, Drift isolation, saved profiles, collision/corner settings and engine-blowout protection remain combined. No unrelated lane candidate or unverified grip/downforce activation is included.

**Verification:** the final combined suite passes 1,873 tests with no failures/skips/cancellations. Exact-native tests exercise retained ownership, real manual requests, OFF acknowledgement and watchdog release; the menu shortcut has five focused tests, including closed-shadow paste behavior. Browser appearance and live race efficacy remain unverified.

**Shift+Insert** now toggles the full tools menu, alongside F8. It does not intercept Paste while typing in text/editable controls. Holding the shortcut does not repeatedly toggle it. Closing follows the same existing menu behavior, including cancelling a running tuner operation.

Reload after enabling only v0.31 and verify the **0.31.0** badge. Keep your chosen settings; start the race yourself. If the unwanted handback persists, export a short new crash log immediately after it occurs.

## Retained v0.30.0: Compact driving information HUD

A small, click-through **Info HUD** appears below the upper-right launcher while the tools menu is closed. **F6** toggles it, or open **F8 → Info HUD**. It starts on and remembers only its display choice in this tab, separately from driving-tool profiles. Opening the menu hides the card until you close it. F7 returns control and F9 still stops driving assists; the HUD itself never enables them.

- **Speed:** existing guarded native speed converted to **km/h**. Zero is shown only when sampled as zero. Unknown builds, invalid car data and paused/missing samples show **Unavailable**, never a guessed or multiplied speed. Older supported builds without verified speed telemetry also show Unavailable.
- **Driver:** observed native AI/manual state, pending handoff, or the reason tools are waiting/paused. A selected AI switch is not called active by itself.
- **Pace:** `req` is the current requested AI target factor; `ack` is a matching native acknowledgement, not measured vehicle speed. A newly selected factor does not reuse an old acknowledgement. Selected pace waits for AI; Drag and Drift retain native pace.
- **Power:** `req` is the selected field multiplier; `set` reports guarded power-field application. It is not measured horsepower or a guaranteed speed increase. Paused, rejected and settling states stay distinct from application.

The HUD is read-only and uses existing observations. Stop, manual takeover, blur, hidden tab, game exit, replacement boot and tuner suspension clear old display evidence. No new physics, AI, speed/power formula, native hook, network permission, tuning, game-save or profile-schema change is included. The complete v0.29 tuner/static-ride fix, online NOS correction, Street X, Drift, Drag and online tools remain together.

**Verification:** 1,788 automated tests pass with no failures/skips/cancellations, including 20 focused HUD tests. A strict-CSP browser fixture is included, but Chromium could not launch because this environment disallowed its local process socket, including the elevated retry. Browser layout/fullscreen behavior and live game appearance remain unverified. No screenshot is presented as actual gameplay.

## Retained v0.29.0: Accept verified native car records in the tuner

The S20 report exposed an incorrect assumption: active car data is not always heap-allocated. The native game also embeds it in its fixed racer-record array. The tuner now accepts those exact native slots **only when the current car, record kind, active record count, race table and ride pointer all agree**. Arbitrary low addresses remain rejected; the existing heap path and all other safety checks remain.

Tests capture all 22 native slots and verify selected-preset-only Stage/Restore across all five modes, including the first and last slots. Native private preview/search matches heap-backed fixtures. The private evaluator permits writes only to the exact ride/curve regions, not neighboring racers or the rest of the copied image. No game save is performed by the extension.

This fixes a proven rejection of valid native car storage. **The user's live capture has not yet been retested.** Reload with only v0.29 enabled, verify 0.29.0, then retry Load settings on the solo Performance Tuning main screen. If another check fails, retain its S-code or export the crash log; later layout protections have not been removed.

The power panel also reports whether power fields were applied, are settling, or are blocked by a specific guard. Exported pace acknowledgement is separate from power application. These are observations, **not a measured speed increase**; no speed, power, driver or network setting is changed by this status addition.

The final v0.29 suite passes **1,768 tests, zero failures/skips/cancellations**. Independent checks cover all 22 native slots, selected Stage/Restore in all five presets, private write boundaries, and unchanged driving code. Power/pace confirmation also clears on stop, online opt-out, game exit, tuner suspension and replacement game sessions.

The online NOS clock correction, working Street X behavior, Drift isolation, profiles, Drag protection and online collision/corner controls remain combined. No unrelated Drag lane candidate or unverified grip/downforce scaling is included. Live driving results and game-save persistence remain unverified.

## Retained v0.28.0: Correct the online Unlimited NOS clock

Unlimited NOS now refreshes an already-active NOS timestamp using the same clock the native game selected. The previous version always used the world clock; in an online fixture where the game's real clock was ahead, that made a full kit immediately appear depleted and caused repeated native stop/restart cycles. The corrected code retains the burst in that exact native test.

This is a reproduced timing defect, **not proof of the clock values in your live run or a guarantee that NOS never stops**. Native AI can still cancel NOS for normal driving decisions. This update does not hold Alt, force activation, suppress native stops or change driving, shifting, steering or lane choice. Inactive and sentinel timestamps remain inactive; network permission and current-car/kit checks remain mandatory.

For an online comparison, use the same ordinary driving situation with **Unlimited NOS** and **Allow network tools** enabled. If tapping remains, use **Export crash log** immediately. The new log samples the selected clock, active-since stamp and kit/resource accounting **before refill**; it contains no pointers. The timestamp flag does not prove successful activation, and sampled logs can miss short transitions.

The v0.28 combined suite passed **1,740 tests, zero failures/skips/cancellations**. Saved tool profiles, working Street X behavior, reviewed Drift isolation, Drag protection, online collision/corner settings and the full tuner with snapshot diagnostics remain together. No native game code or profile was changed. v0.28 did not change tuner capture. The v0.29 native-record correction is described above; any remaining rejection still needs its S-code/log. Live NOS behavior and game-save persistence remain unverified.

## Retained v0.27.0: Identify rejected tuner snapshots

This update replaces the generic “Full tuner snapshot layout is unsupported” message with a specific **S-code and component** when the native capture guard rejects a snapshot. The local diagnostic export records only the bounded failure code and applicable counts, never raw pointers or a memory dump. Details are reset for each request so a previous failure is not shown as a new one.

**This is a diagnostic update, not a confirmed fix for the reported capture failure.** The screenshot establishes that a layout guard rejected the capture, but does not identify which guard or justify weakening it. All existing pointer, ownership, overlap, count, selected-preset and stale-state checks remain. Stage/Restore and game saving are unchanged.

After installing, open the solo Performance Tuning main screen and repeat the failed **Load settings** or **Find tune** once. If it fails, retain the complete S-code/message and use **Export crash log** immediately afterward. Buffer/ownership failures ask for a game reload; other layout failures ask for the diagnostic log. A timeout still means the outcome may be uncertain and requires reloading before retrying.

The combined suite passes **1,708 tests, zero failures/skips/cancellations**, with **49 independent diagnostic checks**. The reviewed Drift isolation, saved tool profiles, Street X behavior, online road-race/collision features and Drag protection are retained. No live gameplay, successful capture on the user's car, or disk-save persistence is claimed.

## Retained v0.26.0: Keep custom road settings out of Drift

On exact **93af6ccb** and **78e2bb69**, custom road/free-roam pace now pauses during native Drift modes. The extension preserves the game's own pace factor instead of multiplying it by a saved road pace setting. Your selected switches and numbers remain saved and resume outside Drift. The UI shows “Paused in Drift”; an earlier road pace hit is not reported as current Drift confirmation.

Extra grip also pauses for the additional native Drift variant flag that was previously missed. Its existing ownership and restoration guards remain. Native Drag precedence is retained. The diagnostic log now includes a bounded, read-only native pace-factor observation to help compare runs.

These are two reproduced setting interactions, **not a proven fix for every poor Drift run**. No new steering, throttle, shifting, NOS behavior, score multiplier, opponent logic, recovery curve or race tune is introduced. Engine power and your actual car tune remain selected and can still affect handling. Native grip/downforce scaling remains unverified and disabled.

Saved tool profiles, full preset tuning, online road-race/collision controls and Drag blowout protection remain combined. The combined suite passes **1,698 tests, zero failures/skips/cancellations**. No live Drift run, score improvement, browser installation or game-save persistence is claimed. For a useful comparison, use the same car, track and tune; export a short diagnostic log after a run that reproduces the problem.

## Retained v0.25.0: Saved extension settings profiles

**Saved tool profiles** saves named groups of extension settings in this browser for this game site. Save your current choices, then load them together instead of enabling each tool separately. Update replaces the selected saved configuration; Delete removes it. These profiles are separate from the game's race tuning presets and **Save Profile**. They contain no car setup, game save, dyno draft or diagnostic log.

Automatic loading after reload is **optional and off by default**. Select it explicitly for a saved configuration if you want that configuration to return next time. Each tool still requires the supported build, valid current car and its normal game-mode checks.

**F9 / Stop keeps saved profiles but pauses automatic loading persistently**, as well as clearing current driving/network choices. A later reload cannot silently undo Stop. Resume deliberately from the profile controls. Saving a profile does not itself enable its settings. Changes from another tab do not automatically activate a configuration in an already-open tab.

Profile loading stops the old controllers and releases synthetic input before changing selections. It does not roll back a staged game tune or save the game. If storage is unavailable or full, the UI reports that the profile was not saved. Profiles stay in this browser; clearing this site's storage removes them, and site scripts can access this storage. Up to 16 profiles and 48 characters per name are supported. Saved Drag blowout protection retains its narrow meaning: only the current eligible local engine is protected before it blows; online use also needs network permission. It does not revive an already-blown engine, alter NOS/shifting, or promise a race win. Existing controls keep their normal fresh-page defaults unless you explicitly enable a saved startup profile. Descriptions below that say a control starts off refer to those defaults.

No native AI, Street X, tuning, heat, corner/braking or collision payload was changed for settings profiles. The final suite passes 1,688 tests, with another 44 independent profile checks.
