  }
  function pendingCornerText(state) {
    // Existing read-only evidence only. Stages are the furthest native check
    // reached for this request, not a diagnosis of the latest turn or failure.
    // A missing hit does not prove the road has no qualifying bends.
    if (state.cornerHits > 0) return 'Armed · waiting for current settings confirmation';
    if (state.cornerRouteOwned === true && state.cornerPlannerCorners === 0) return 'Armed · native plan currently has no corner entries';
    if (state.cornerProbeStage === 6) return 'Armed · limiting curve seen; reduction not confirmed';
    if (state.cornerProbeStage === 5) return 'Armed · planner reached; no speed reduction recorded';
    if (state.cornerProbeStage >= 1 && state.cornerProbeStage <= 4) return 'Armed · native corner checks not yet complete';
    return 'Armed · no native corner reduction recorded';
  }
  function cornerEvidenceText(state) {
    const count = value => Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 40 ? value : 'unknown';
    const stage = Number.isInteger(state.cornerProbeStage) && state.cornerProbeStage >= 0 && state.cornerProbeStage <= 7 ? state.cornerProbeStage : 'unknown';
    const mask = Number.isInteger(state.cornerGuardMask) && state.cornerGuardMask >= 0 && state.cornerGuardMask <= 255 ? state.cornerGuardMask : null;
    const checks = [[1,'command/profile'],[2,'AI ownership'],[4,'game context'],[8,'race state'],[16,'drag/drift exclusion'],[32,'network permission'],[64,'driver identity'],[128,'private route']];
    const sampled = mask === null ? 'unknown' : mask ? checks.filter(([bit]) => mask & bit).map(([,name]) => name).join(', ') : 'none';
    return `Native route points: ${count(state.cornerRouteNodes)}; corner entries: ${count(state.cornerPlannerCorners)}. Furthest native check: ${stage}/7; 7 means a hit exists. Sampled unmet checks: ${sampled}. Counts/checks are snapshots, not a proven cause. Export a short crash log after several turns if no reduction is recorded.`;
  }
  const NativeWorker = window.Worker;
  // Observe only the known game worker; AI validates its patched module separately.
  window.Worker = new Proxy(NativeWorker, {
    construct(Target, args, NewTarget) {
      const worker = Reflect.construct(Target, args, NewTarget);
      let url; try { url = new URL(String(args[0]), location.href); } catch { return worker; }
      if (url.origin !== location.origin || url.pathname !== '/host/game-worker.js') return worker;
      const send = worker.postMessage;
      let bootSession=null;
      worker.postMessage = function (m, ...rest) {
        if (m && m.mod instanceof WebAssembly.Module && m.memory instanceof WebAssembly.Memory && Number.isSafeInteger(m.slot) && m.slot>=0) {
          if(m.slot===0){
          const verifiedProfile=AI?.getModuleProfile?.(m.mod)||null;
          if (!engine || engine.memory !== m.memory || activeModule!==m.mod || activeWorker!==worker || moduleProfile!==verifiedProfile) {
            // Release only the previous verified session before sending the new
            // module to its worker. A reused memory object is not an identity.
            if(engine&&moduleProfile){try{const state=engine.state();engine.restorePerformance(state);engine.restoreGrip(state);}catch{}}
            dyno?.cancel();wall?.stop();cars?.stop();ai?.stop();
            sessionGeneration++;activeWorker=worker;activeModule=m.mod;moduleProfile=verifiedProfile;refreshCompatibility();
            // A new module/worker/memory generation has no current native
            // observations yet. Do not carry prior application or ownership
            // evidence into its boot event or an immediate diagnostic export.
            diagnosticState={generation:sessionGeneration,revision:moduleProfile?.revision||'unknown',supported,ready:false,driving:false,safe:false,tools:diagnosticTools()};
            clearApplicationEvidence('not-ready');
            diagnosticIdentity=null;
            recordDiagnostic('game-boot',{generation:sessionGeneration,slot:m.slot,memoryMiB:m.memory.buffer.byteLength/1048576,revision:moduleProfile?.revision||'unknown',supported,tools:diagnosticTools()});
            const caps=moduleProfile?.capabilities;
            dyno=caps?.fullTuner && globalThis.__NFSU2_DYNO_FULL__?.Controller?new globalThis.__NFSU2_DYNO_FULL__.Controller(m.memory,true,moduleProfile.revision,{prepared:AI.getNativeEvaluator(m.mod),module:m.mod}):caps?.dyno && globalThis.__NFSU2_DYNO__?.Controller?new globalThis.__NFSU2_DYNO__.Controller(m.memory,true,moduleProfile.revision):null;dyno?.setEnabled(dynoEnabled);
            wall=caps?.walls && Walls?.Controller?new Walls.Controller(m.memory,true,moduleProfile.wall):null;
            cars=caps?.cars && Cars?.Controller?new Cars.Controller(m.memory,true,moduleProfile.cars):null;
            ai=AI?.Controller?new AI.Controller(m.memory,!!caps?.ai,caps):null;
            engine = new Engine(m.memory,moduleProfile?.statusCapacity); statusPtr = 0; inputPtr = 0; driftPending = null; driftNeedsReapply=typeof prefs.drift==='boolean'; powerGate.reset(); gripGate.reset();
          }
          }
          bootSession={module:m.mod,memory:m.memory,generation:activeModule===m.mod&&engine?.memory===m.memory?sessionGeneration:-1};
        }
        return Reflect.apply(send, this, [m, ...rest]);
      };
      const currentSession = () => !!bootSession && bootSession.generation===sessionGeneration && bootSession.module===activeModule && bootSession.memory===engine?.memory;
      worker.addEventListener('error', event => recordDiagnostic('worker-error',{sessionCurrent:currentSession(),error:event.error || event.message,tools:diagnosticTools()}));
      worker.addEventListener('message', event => {
        const m = event.data;
        if(m?.t==='trap')recordDiagnostic('game-trap',{sessionCurrent:currentSession(),tid:m.tid,error:m.msg,stack:m.stack,tools:diagnosticTools()});
        if(m?.t==='exit')recordDiagnostic('game-exit',{sessionCurrent:currentSession(),code:m.code,tools:diagnosticTools()});
        if(!currentSession())return;
        if(m?.t==='register' && (m.kind===3||m.kind===5))recordDiagnostic('game-register',{kind:m.kind});
        if (worker===activeWorker && m?.t === 'register' && m.kind === 3 && Number.isSafeInteger(m.ptr)) inputPtr = m.ptr;
        if (worker===activeWorker && m?.t === 'register' && m.kind === 5 && Number.isSafeInteger(m.ptr)) statusPtr = m.ptr;
        if (m?.t === 'exit' || m?.t === 'trap') {suspend('Game stopped. Enabled choices are kept for the next game.');ai=null;wall=null;cars=null;dyno=null;engine=null;activeWorker=null;activeModule=null;moduleProfile=null;refreshCompatibility();statusPtr=0;inputPtr=0;}
      });
      return worker;
    }
  });
  // A different game revision must be reviewed before writing its memory.
  fetch('/game.json', { cache: 'no-store', credentials: 'omit' }).then(r => {
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('Build information unavailable');
    return r.json();

  function key(code, down) {
    const keyName = { ArrowUp: 'ArrowUp', ShiftLeft: 'Shift', AltLeft: 'Alt' }[code] || code;
    window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(down ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code, key: keyName,
      location: /Left$/.test(code) ? 1 : 0, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
  }
  function hold(code, down) {
    if (down && !held.has(code)) { if (!physicallyHeld.has(code)) { held.add(code); key(code, true); } }
    else if (!down && held.delete(code) && !physicallyHeld.has(code)) key(code, false);
  }
  function release() { clearTimeout(shiftTimer); for (const code of [...held]) hold(code, false); }
  function suspend(why) {
    dyno?.cancel();
    wall?.stop();cars?.stop(); ai?.stop(); release(); powerGate.reset(); gripGate.reset();
    try {if(engine){const state=engine.state();engine.restorePerformance(state);engine.restoreGrip(state);}} catch { /* no stale pointer writes */ }
    clearApplicationEvidence();
    if(why) message(why);
  }
  function stop(why = 'Driving controls off. F9 cleared driving assists and network permission. Saved profiles are kept. Load one manually, or select it and enable Load on startup to resume.', persistProfilePause=true) {
    profileStartup=null;loadedProfile=null;profileActionEpoch++;profileActionPending=false;if(profileDriftChoice)driftNeedsReapply=false;profileDriftChoice=false;
    // Keep an already-issued drift request pending until confirmation/timeout: a
    // native toggle cannot be recalled safely, and a second must not overlap it.
    if(persistProfilePause){
      profileSessionStopped=true;
      try{sessionStorage.setItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP,'1');}catch{}
      const result=profileStore?.pause();
      profileNotice=result?.error||'Automatic loading paused by Stop. Select a profile and enable Load on startup to resume.';
      renderProfiles();
    }
    recordDiagnostic('stop',{tools:diagnosticTools()});
    clearRaceOnlyAI();
    dynoEnabled=false;dyno?.setEnabled(false);if(ui)ui.querySelector('#dyno-enable').checked=false;
    adaptiveRaceEnabled=false;if(ui)ui.querySelector('#adaptive-race').checked=false;
    prefs.raceCornerAssist=false;prefs.cornerAssist=false;prefs.racePace=false;prefs.walls=false;prefs.cars=false;prefs.traffic=false;prefs.players=false;prefs.online=false;prefs.ai=false;prefs.aiPace=false;prefs.nos=false;prefs.dragNoBlowout=false;prefs.drag=false;prefs.boost=false;prefs.unlimit=false;prefs.grip=false;savePrefs();suspend();
    if(ui) for(const id of ['race-corner-assist','corner-assist','race-pace','walls','cars','traffic','players','online','ai','ai-pace','nos','drag-no-blowout','drag','boost','unlimit','grip']) ui.querySelector('#'+id).checked=false;
    message(profileNotice&&persistProfilePause ? why+' '+profileNotice : why);
  }
  function clearRaceOnlyAI() {
    raceOnlyAI=false;
    if(ui){ui.querySelector('#race-only-ai').checked=false;ui.querySelector('#race-only-state').textContent='Off · current page only';}
  }
  function setRaceOnlyAI(enabled) {
    raceOnlyAI=enabled===true;
    if(raceOnlyAI){prefs.ai=false;if(ui)ui.querySelector('#ai').checked=false;}
    ai?.stop();release();clearPaceEvidence();savePrefs();
    if(ui){ui.querySelector('#race-only-ai').checked=raceOnlyAI;ui.querySelector('#race-only-state').textContent=raceOnlyAI?'Armed · waiting for an eligible race':'Off · current page only';}

F7/F9 or driving keys during a race disarm it. Reload or profile Load turns it off.':'Race-only AI off. Native handback may complete on the next game frame.');
  }
  function raceOnlyRaceContext() {
    // Manual driving in free roam should not cancel arming for the next race.
    // Read the current context so an old sample cannot ignore race takeover.
    if(!supported||!engine||!statusPtr)return false;
    try {const state=engine.state(),hud=engine.status(statusPtr)?.drive;return !!state.ready&&Number.isFinite(hud)&&(hud&3)===1&&engine.u32(0x89e7b0)===1;}catch{return false;}
  }
  function takeControl() {
    recordDiagnostic('manual',{tools:diagnosticTools()});
    clearRaceOnlyAI();
    prefs.ai=false; ai?.stop(); dragTakenOver=true; release(); savePrefs();
    try {clearPaceEvidence();} catch {}
    if(ui) {ui.querySelector('#ai').checked=false;ui.querySelector('#ai-state').textContent='Manual control · native AI off';}
    message('Returning control to you. Native AI is off on the next game frame. Toggle drag assist again if you want assisted throttle.');
  }
  window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (!e.isTrusted) return;
    if(e.code==='Insert' && e.shiftKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.altKey && !e.metaKey){
      // Shift+Insert remains Paste in text/editable controls, including controls
      // inside a shadow root. Otherwise it mirrors the existing F8 menu action.
      const path=e.composedPath?.()||[e.target];
      const editingNode=node=>{
        for(let depth=0;node&&depth<32;depth++,node=node.parentElement){
          if(node.isContentEditable || node.getAttribute?.('role')==='textbox' || /^(TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(node.tagName) || (node.tagName==='INPUT' && !/^(button|checkbox|radio|range|submit|reset|color|file|image|hidden)$/.test(String(node.type||'').toLowerCase())))return true;
        }
        return false;
      };
      // Window's composedPath hides our closed shadow tree. Its retained
      // activeElement is required to preserve Paste in the profile-name field.
      const editing=[...path,ui?.activeElement,document.activeElement].some(editingNode);
      if(e.isComposing || e.defaultPrevented || editing)return;
      e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)setPanel(!visible);return;
    }
    // Range controls keep their native arrow/Space behavior without taking over the car.
    if(host && e.composedPath?.().includes(host) && !['F6','F7','F8','F9','Escape'].includes(e.code)) return;
    if(e.code==='F6'){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)setInfoHud(!infoHudEnabled);return;}
    physicallyHeld.add(e.code);
    if(e.code==='F7') {e.preventDefault();takeControl();}
    else if((prefs.ai || (raceOnlyAI && raceOnlyRaceContext())) && ['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','ArrowDown','KeyW','KeyA','KeyS','KeyD','Space'].includes(e.code)) takeControl();
    if (e.code === 'F8') { e.preventDefault(); setPanel(!visible); }
    if (e.code === 'Escape' && visible) setPanel(false);
    if (e.code === 'F9') { e.preventDefault(); stop(); }
  }, true);
  window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.isTrusted) physicallyHeld.delete(e.code); }, true);
  window.addEventListener('focus', () => recordDiagnostic('resume',{reason:'blur',tools:diagnosticTools()}));
  window.addEventListener('blur', () => { recordDiagnostic('pause',{reason:'blur',tools:diagnosticTools()}); physicallyHeld.clear(); suspend('Paused while unfocused. Enabled tools resume when you return to a supported driving mode.'); });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { recordDiagnostic(document.hidden?'pause':'resume',{reason:'hidden',hidden:document.hidden,tools:diagnosticTools()}); if (document.hidden) suspend('Paused while the tab is hidden. Your enabled choices are kept.'); });
  window.addEventListener('storage',event=>{
    if(!ToolProfiles||![null,ToolProfiles.KEY,ToolProfiles.STOP_KEY].includes(event.key))return;
    const after=profileStore.refresh();
    const changed=loadedProfile&&!after.data.profiles.some(p=>p.id===loadedProfile.id&&p.revision===loadedProfile.revision);
    if(event.key===null||event.key===ToolProfiles.STOP_KEY||!after.available||changed){
      stop('Profile storage or Stop changed in another tab. Current driving controls are off. Load a profile explicitly to resume.',false);
      profileSessionStopped=true;try{sessionStorage.setItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP,'1');}catch{}
    }
    profileSelection=null;profileNotice=after.error||'Profiles updated in another tab. Select a profile again; nothing was automatically loaded.';renderProfiles();
  });
  window.addEventListener('pageshow',event=>{
    if(!event.persisted)return;
    // A BFCache page must recheck durable Stop and profile permissions before it
    // resumes. Do not auto-reload a profile or revive a retained controller.
    stop('Page restored. Driving controls remain off; load a profile explicitly to resume.',false);
    profileStore?.refresh();profileSelection=null;profileNotice='Page restored with controls off. Select and Load a profile to resume.';renderProfiles();
    clearInterval(timer);timer=setInterval(tick,50);
  });
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { recordDiagnostic('page-hide',{reason:'page-hide',tools:diagnosticTools()});savePrefs(); suspend(); clearInterval(timer); });

  function setDrift(wanted) {
    if (driftPending) return false;
    const state = engine?.state(), counters = engine && statusPtr ? engine.status(statusPtr) : null;
    if (!supported || !state?.ready || !state.driving || state.network || !counters || (counters.drive & 3) !== 2 || !Number.isFinite(counters.drift) || document.hidden || document.querySelector('dialog[open]')) {
      message('Drift assist only works while driving solo free roam with the game menus closed.'); return false;
    }
    if (!!(counters.drift & 1) === wanted) return true;
    // Rebuilding the native drift setup must not inherit our power multiplier.
    engine.restorePerformance(state);engine.restoreGrip(state);powerGate.reset();gripGate.reset();
    if (!engine.driftTap(inputPtr)) { message('Drift request not sent: the game input mailbox is unavailable, inactive, typing, or full.'); return false; }
    driftPending = { wanted, until: performance.now() + 3000 };
    ui.querySelector('#drift').disabled = true;
    message('Drift request sent. Waiting for the game to confirm its handling state…');
    return true;
  }
  function moduleFailure() {
    const patch=AI?.patchState;
    if(moduleProfile || patch?.phase!=='unavailable')return '';
    const reported=/^[a-f0-9]{8,40}$/.test(revision)?` Site reports build ${revision}.`:'';
    const bytes=Number.isSafeInteger(patch.moduleBytes)?` Loaded module: ${patch.moduleBytes} bytes.`:'';
    const signatures=Number.isInteger(patch.signatureUnique)?` Fingerprints: ${patch.signatureUnique}/${patch.signatureTotal} unique matches; this does not approve an unknown build.`:'';
    return ['module-size','module-hash'].includes(patch.patchCode)
      ? `Game module is not verified.${reported}${bytes} A compatible Driving Tools update is required.${signatures}`
      : `Game module could not be prepared.${reported} Reload once. If it persists, export the diagnostic log.`;
  }

      if(ui){const status=diagnostics?.status();ui.querySelector('#diagnostic-state').textContent=status?`${status.events} recent events · ${status.persistence==='same-tab'?'kept across reloads in this tab':'memory only; storage unavailable'}`:'Logger unavailable';if(status&&Number.isInteger(patch?.signatureUnique))ui.querySelector('#diagnostic-state').textContent+=` · fingerprints ${patch.signatureUnique}/${patch.signatureTotal}`;}
    } catch {}

        ui.querySelector('#drag-state').textContent = activeDrag ? dragCountdown ? 'Countdown throttle · shifts wait for GO' : 'Throttle + shifting active · you steer' : prefs.drag ? dragAIRequested ? 'Paused while automatic drag AI is requested' : dragTakenOver ? 'Paused by manual takeover · toggle to resume' : dragRace && !manualDriver ? 'Waiting for native AI to release the car' : s.network && !prefs.online ? 'Paused online · enable Session mode opt-in' : 'Waiting for drag driving state' : 'Throttle + shifting · you steer';
        ui.querySelector('#grip-state').textContent=grip.active ? `Tyre-force multiplier ${grip.factor.toFixed(1)}× applied` : prefs.grip ? (grip.reason || 'Waiting for driving state') : 'More tyre grip · start at 1.3×';
        if (prefs.tester && supported && s.ready && now - lastScan > 250) {
          lastScan = now;
          const h = engine.hazards(s), close = h?.cars[0];
          ui.querySelector('#hazards').textContent = h ? `${h.scannedCars} car objects read. ${close ? `Nearest ahead: ${close.ahead.toFixed(0)} m, side offset ${close.side.toFixed(1)} m.` : 'No nearby car detected ahead.'} ${h.barrierAhead !== null ? `Barrier line ahead: ${h.barrierAhead.toFixed(0)} m.` : 'No crossing barrier line detected.'} Props and general obstacles: NOT detected.` : 'Detector waiting for valid car coordinates.';
        }
        const driftKnown = counters && Number.isFinite(counters.drift);
        const drift = driftKnown ? !!(counters.drift & 1) : null;
        const driftActive = driftKnown && !!(counters.drift & 2);
        if (driftPending && driftKnown && drift === driftPending.wanted && (!drift || driftActive)) {
          message(drift ? 'Drift assist ON: confirmed by the game’s handling state.' : 'Drift assist OFF: confirmed by the game.'); driftPending=null;
        } else if (driftPending && now > driftPending.until) {
          message('The game did not confirm drift assist. Use solo free roam (not a race or co-op), close menus, then try again.'); driftPending=null;
        }
        ui.querySelector('#drift').disabled = !!driftPending;
        if(driftNeedsReapply && !driftPending && safe && driveStatus===2 && driftKnown) {driftNeedsReapply=false;if(!setDrift(prefs.drift))message('Drift request could not be sent. Toggle it again in free roam.');}
        if(driftKnown && !driftPending && !driftNeedsReapply) {
          ui.querySelector('#drift').checked=drift;
          if(typeof prefs.drift==='boolean' && prefs.drift!==drift){prefs.drift=drift;savePrefs();}
        }
        for(const id of ['ai-state','race-only-state','ai-pace-state','race-pace-state','race-corner-state','corner-state','grip-state','walls-state','cars-state','traffic-state','players-state','drag-state','drag-ai-state','online-state']) {const node=ui.querySelector('#'+id);node.title=node.textContent;}
        for(const [id,mode] of [['corner-state',1],['race-corner-state',2]]) if(aiState.cornerRequested && aiState.cornerMode===mode) {const node=ui.querySelector('#'+id);node.title=node.textContent+' · '+cornerEvidenceText(aiState);}
        ui.querySelector('#drift-state').textContent = driftNeedsReapply ? 'Choice saved · waiting for solo free roam' : driftPending ? 'Waiting for confirmation…' : driftActive ? 'Game confirms drift handling ON' : drift ? 'Selected, but not active in this game mode' : 'Free roam only · not perfect-drift automation';
      }
    } catch (error) { recordDiagnostic('engine-error',{error,tools:diagnosticTools()});stop('Runtime changed or is unavailable. Reload the game before retrying.'); engine = null; }
  }

  function updateDynoUI() {
    if(!ui)return;
    const busy=!!dyno?.busy,ready=!!(dynoEnabled && supported && dyno?.canUse() && !document.hidden && document.hasFocus());
    const context=ready&&!busy?dyno?.syncContext?.():null;
    if(context?.invalidated)dynoText='Car tuning or installed parts changed. Load settings or find a new tune for this game mode.';
    else if(context?.changed)dynoText=dyno.applied?'Applied tune found for this car and mode. Restore is available while it stays unchanged.':dyno.outcome?'Preview found for this car and mode. Review it before Apply.':'Ready for the selected mode. Load all settings or search a measured native estimate.';
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-mode').textContent=context?`Game tuning slot ${context.kind+1} of 5${Tune?.MODE_LABELS?.[context.kind]?' · '+Tune.MODE_LABELS[context.kind]:''} · selected in Mode Select`:busy&&dyno?.context?`Game tuning slot ${dyno.context.kind+1} of 5`:'Choose a race mode in the game, then open the Dyno main screen.';
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-find').disabled=!ready || busy || !!dyno?.applied;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-cancel').disabled=!busy;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-apply').disabled=!ready || busy || !(dyno?.full?dyno.outcome?.changed:dyno?.outcome?.improved) || !!dyno?.applied;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-restore').disabled=!ready || busy || !dyno?.applied;
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').disabled=busy;
    for(const option of ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').options||[])if(['acceleration60','acceleration100','topSpeed'].includes(option.value))option.disabled=!dyno?.full;
    if(dyno && !dyno.full&&['acceleration60','acceleration100','topSpeed'].includes(ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value))ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value='peakPower';
    updateSetupEditor(ready,busy);
    ui.querySelector('#dyno-state').textContent=moduleFailure()?`Dyno unavailable. ${moduleFailure()}`:moduleProfile&&!moduleProfile.capabilities.dyno?'Not yet verified for this build':dynoText;

  const tuneValue=value=>(value>100?'+':'')+(value-100);
  function updateSetupEditor(ready,busy){
    const editor=dyno?.editor,editable=!!(ready&&!busy&&editor&&!dyno?.applied);
    ui.querySelector('#tune-load').disabled=!ready||busy||!!dyno?.applied||!dyno?.full;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-preview').disabled=!editable;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-reset').disabled=!editable;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-group').disabled=!editable;
    const group=Tune?.GROUPS?.find(g=>g.id===ui.querySelector('#tune-group').value)||Tune?.GROUPS?.[0];
    for(let i=0;i<9;i++){
      const offset=group?.offsets[i],present=!!editor&&offset!==undefined,row=ui.querySelector('#tune-row-'+i),input=ui.querySelector('#tune-input-'+i);
      row.hidden=!present;input.disabled=!editable||!editor?.allowedOffsets.includes(offset);
      if(present){
        input.dataset.offset=String(offset);input.value=editor.draft[offset]-100;
        ui.querySelector('#tune-label-'+i).textContent=(Tune?.FIELD_LABELS?.[offset]||'Setting '+(offset+1))+(editor.allowedOffsets.includes(offset)?'':editor.unlockedOffsets?.includes(offset)?' · unverified':' · locked');
        ui.querySelector('#tune-value-'+i).textContent=tuneValue(editor.draft[offset]);
      }
    }
    const o=dyno?.outcome;
    ui.querySelector('#tune-changes').textContent=dyno?.full&&Array.isArray(o?.changes)?o.changes.map(x=>`${Tune?.FIELD_LABELS?.[x.offset]||x.field}: ${tuneValue(x.before)} → ${tuneValue(x.after)}${x.adjusted?' (native adjusted request '+tuneValue(x.requested)+')':''}`).join('\n')||'No accepted setup changes.':editor?'Edit sliders, then Preview changes. Drafts never alter the game.':'Load settings to see unlocked controls for this car and preset.';
  }
  async function runDyno(action) {
    if(!dynoEnabled || !dyno || dyno.busy)return;
    recordDiagnostic('dyno-action',{reason:action,tools:diagnosticTools()});
    suspend();
    dyno.setEnabled(true);
    try {
      if(action==='load'){
        await dyno.loadSetup();dynoText='All supported settings loaded. Edit a category, then Preview. Nothing changes in the game until Stage.';
      } else if(action==='preview'){
        const r=await dyno.preview();
        dynoText=`${r.changed?'Preview ready. Review accepted changes, then Stage selected preset.':'No accepted setup changes.'} Game unchanged. Native estimates: 0–60 ${r.bestResult.zeroTo60Seconds.toFixed(2)} s; 0–100 ${r.bestResult.zeroTo100Seconds.toFixed(2)} s; top ${(r.bestResult.topSpeedMps*3.6).toFixed(1)} km/h; ${r.bestResult.peakPowerKw.toFixed(1)} kW / ${r.bestResult.peakTorqueNm.toFixed(1)} Nm. NOS ${r.bestResult.nitrousSeconds.toFixed(2)} s / torque setting ${r.bestResult.nitrousTorque.toFixed(3)}. No handling/lap-time measurement.`;
      } else if(action==='find') {
        dynoText=dyno.full?'Searching in private memory · game setup stays unchanged':'Searching · original setup is restored after each trial';updateDynoUI();
        const r=await dyno.find({goal:ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value,onProgress:p=>{dynoText=`Searching ${p.evaluations}/${p.budget} trials · Cancel or F9 to stop`;updateDynoUI();}});
        const [field,unit]=({peakPower:['peakPowerKw','kW'],peakTorque:['peakTorqueNm','Nm'],acceleration60:['zeroTo60Seconds','s (0–60)'],acceleration100:['zeroTo100Seconds','s (0–100)'],topSpeed:['topSpeedMps','m/s']}[r.goal]);
        if(dyno.full){
          const manualSeed=r.seed?.some((value,index)=>value!==r.baseline[index]);
          const seedText=manualSeed&&r.changed?(r.improvedFromSeed?' Search improved the measured goal over your draft.':' No further measured improvement over the draft. Accepted manual draft retained.'):'';
          dynoText=`${r.baselineResult[field].toFixed(1)} → ${r.bestResult[field].toFixed(1)} ${unit} · ${r.evaluations} trials. Original kept. ${r.improved?'Measured goal improved versus original.':'No measured goal improvement versus original.'}${seedText} ${r.changed?'Review accepted changes, then Stage selected preset.':'No accepted setup changes.'} No handling/lap-time measurement.`;
        }else dynoText=`${r.baselineResult[field].toFixed(1)} → ${r.bestResult[field].toFixed(1)} ${unit} · ${r.evaluations} trials. Original kept. ${r.improved?'Stage preview to use this tune.':'No improvement found.'}`;
      } else if(action==='apply') {const r=await dyno.apply();dynoText=dyno.full?'Selected preset staged. Use the game’s Test Run to refresh driving physics, and Save Profile to persist. Disk save is not confirmed.'+(r.saveReady?'':' Other presets also have unsaved edits; native Save Profile saves them too.'):'Best tune applied. Use native Save Profile to persist.';}
      else {await dyno.restore();dynoText=dyno.full?'Previous current and selected-visit settings restored. Test Run refreshes physics. Save Profile again if you want this restored version persisted.':'Previous tune restored and confirmed.';}
    } catch(error) {recordDiagnostic('dyno-error',{error,dynoStatus:error?.dynoStatus,dynoGuard:error?.dynoGuard,dynoObserved:error?.dynoObserved,tools:diagnosticTools()});dynoText=error?.message || 'Dyno tuner stopped. Reload before retrying.';}
    updateDynoUI();
  }
  function exportDiagnostic() {
    if(!diagnostics){message('Diagnostic logger is unavailable. The game’s Download log may still have crash details.');return;}
    let url=null,link=null;
    try {
      recordDiagnostic('export',{tools:diagnosticTools()});
      const blob=new Blob([diagnostics.exportText()],{type:'application/json'});
      url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);link=document.createElement('a');link.href=url;link.download='nfsu2-driving-tools-diagnostics.json';link.hidden=true;
      (document.body||document.documentElement).append(link);link.click();
      message('Diagnostic download requested. It stays local until you choose to share the file. For native crash details, also use the game’s Download log.');
    } catch(error) {recordDiagnostic('engine-error',{error});message('Diagnostic download failed. Try again, or use the game’s Download log.');}
    finally {link?.remove();if(url)setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);}
  }
  const profileToggleIds={raceCornerAssist:'race-corner-assist',cornerAssist:'corner-assist',racePace:'race-pace',walls:'walls',cars:'cars',traffic:'traffic',players:'players',online:'online',ai:'ai',aiPace:'ai-pace',nos:'nos',dragNoBlowout:'drag-no-blowout',drag:'drag',tester:'tester',boost:'boost',unlimit:'unlimit',grip:'grip'};
  const profileNumericBindings=[['race-corner-factor','raceCornerFactor','race-corner-value',2,'×'],['race-corner-margin','raceCornerMargin','race-corner-margin-value',0,'%'],['race-braking','raceBraking','race-braking-value',2,'×'],['race-pace-factor','racePaceFactor','race-pace-value',2,'×'],['corner-factor','cornerFactor','corner-value',2,'×'],['corner-margin','cornerMargin','corner-margin-value',0,'%'],['pace-factor','paceFactor','pace-value',2,'×'],['rpm','rpm','rpm-value',0,''],['power','power','power-value',1,'×'],['grip-factor','gripFactor','grip-value',1,'×']];
  function syncProfileControls(){
    if(!ui)return;
    for(const [key,id]of Object.entries(profileToggleIds))ui.querySelector('#'+id).checked=prefs[key];

    ui.querySelector('#hazards').hidden=!prefs.tester;
  }
  const profileLocks=()=>typeof navigator!=='undefined'&&navigator.locks&&typeof navigator.locks.request==='function'?navigator.locks:null;
  function renderProfiles(){
    if(!ui)return;
    const state=profileStore?.snapshot(),select=ui.querySelector('#profile-select');
    select.replaceChildren();const empty=document.createElement('option');empty.value='';empty.textContent='Choose a saved profile';select.append(empty);
    for(const p of state?.data.profiles||[]){const option=document.createElement('option');option.value=p.id;option.textContent=p.name;select.append(option);}
    const selected=state?.data.profiles.find(p=>p.id===profileSelection?.id&&p.revision===profileSelection?.revision);
    if(!selected){profileSelection=null;ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=false;}
    select.value=selected?.id||'';
    for(const id of ['profile-load','profile-update','profile-delete','profile-auto'])ui.querySelector('#'+id).disabled=profileActionPending||!state?.available||!selected||(id!=='profile-load'&&!profileLocks());
    ui.querySelector('#profile-save').disabled=profileActionPending||!state?.available||!profileLocks();
    for(const id of ['profile-select','profile-name','profile-network'])ui.querySelector('#'+id).disabled=profileActionPending;
    ui.querySelector('#profile-auto').checked=!!selected&&state.data.auto?.id===selected.id&&state.data.auto.stopToken===state.stopToken&&!profileSessionStopped;
    ui.querySelector('#profile-state').textContent=state?.error||(profileActionPending?'Waiting for another tab to finish saving profiles.':profileNotice)||(!profileLocks()?'Profile editing is unavailable because this browser cannot lock local saves.':!profileStore?'Profiles unavailable; existing controls still work.':state.paused?'Automatic loading paused by Stop. Select a profile and enable Load on startup to resume.':state.data.auto?'A saved profile will load on next startup.':'Automatic loading is off. Save current controls, then select and Load when needed.');
  }
  function selectProfile(){
    const id=ui.querySelector('#profile-select').value,state=profileStore?.refresh();
    profileSelection=state?.data.profiles.find(p=>p.id===id)||null;
    ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value=profileSelection?.name||'';

    profileNotice=profileSelection?'Selected '+profileSelection.name+'. Load applies its saved choices. Update replaces it with current controls.':'';renderProfiles();
  }
  function applyToolProfile(result,automatic=false){
    if(driftPending)throw Error('Wait for the current drift request to confirm or time out, then Load again. No profile was loaded.');
    if(dyno?.busy||dyno?.pending){dyno.cancel();throw Error('Tuner cancellation requested. Wait for the pending game request to finish, then Load again. A staged preset is not reverted.');}
    clearRaceOnlyAI();
    adaptiveRaceEnabled=false;if(ui)ui.querySelector('#adaptive-race').checked=false;
    suspend();driftNeedsReapply=false;dragTakenOver=false;lastShift=0;lastPulse=0;
    const choices=result.settings;
    for(const key of Object.keys(prefs))prefs[key]=choices[key];
    dynoEnabled=choices.dynoEnabled;dyno?.setEnabled(dynoEnabled);
    if(ui){ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value=choices.dynoGoal;ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=result.profile.networkConsent;ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value=result.profile.name;}
    driftNeedsReapply=typeof prefs.drift==='boolean';profileDriftChoice=driftNeedsReapply;
    loadedProfile={id:result.profile.id,revision:result.profile.revision};savePrefs();syncProfileControls();
    dynoText=dynoEnabled?'Profile loaded. Open the solo Performance Tuning main screen. Existing staged presets are unchanged.':'Tuner off. Existing staged presets are unchanged.';updateDynoUI();
    profileNotice=(automatic?'Loaded on startup: ':'Loaded: ')+result.profile.name+'. Choices wait for verified game contexts.'+(result.profile.networkConsent?' Saved network permission restored where selected.':' Network permission and online no-clip remain off.')+' Game presets and drafts are not saved or restored by profiles.';
    message(profileNotice);renderProfiles();
  }
  function profileAction(action){
    if(profileActionPending)return;
    const request={stopToken:profileStore?.snapshot().stopToken,selection:profileSelection?{...profileSelection}:null,name:ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value,networkConsent:ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked===true,auto:ui.querySelector('#profile-auto').checked,settings:{...prefs,dynoEnabled,dynoGoal:ui.querySelector('#dyno-goal').value}};
    const epoch=profileActionEpoch;
    // localStorage has no atomic compare-and-swap. Serialize named-profile
    // writes across tabs with a browser-managed lock; Stop remains immediate
    // and its independent marker invalidates any stale startup authorization.
    const execute=()=>{
      if(epoch!==profileActionEpoch)return;
      if(action==='auto'){
        const latest=profileStore?.refresh();
        if(!latest?.available||latest.stopToken!==request.stopToken){profileNotice='Stop or profile storage changed while waiting. Select a profile and request startup loading again.';renderProfiles();return;}
      }
      performProfileAction(action,request);
    };
    if(action==='load'){execute();return;}
    const locks=profileLocks();
    if(!locks){profileNotice='Profile editing needs browser storage locking, which is unavailable. No profile was changed.';renderProfiles();return;}
    profileActionPending=true;renderProfiles();
    try{
      const result=locks.request('nfsu2-driving-tools-profiles-v1-write',execute);
      if(result&&typeof result.then==='function')result.catch(()=>{if(epoch===profileActionEpoch)profileNotice='Could not lock profile storage. No profile change was confirmed.';}).finally(()=>{if(epoch===profileActionEpoch){profileActionPending=false;renderProfiles();}});
      else {profileActionPending=false;renderProfiles();}
    }catch{profileActionPending=false;profileNotice='Could not lock profile storage. No profile change was confirmed.';renderProfiles();}
  }
  function performProfileAction(action,request){
    const selected=request.selection;
    try{
      if(!profileStore)throw Error('Profiles are unavailable.');
      if(action==='save'||action==='update'){
        if(action==='update'&&!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        const saved=profileStore.save({id:action==='update'?selected.id:null,revision:action==='update'?selected.revision:null,name:request.name,settings:request.settings,networkConsent:request.networkConsent});
        profileSelection=saved;profileNotice='Saved '+saved.name+' locally in this browser. This profile will not load on startup until explicitly enabled.';
      }else if(action==='load'){
        if(!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        applyToolProfile(profileStore.load(selected.id,selected.revision));return;
      }else if(action==='delete'){
        if(!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        profileStore.remove(selected.id,selected.revision);profileSelection=null;ui.querySelector('#profile-name').value='';ui.querySelector('#profile-network').checked=false;profileNotice='Saved profile deleted. Current controls are unchanged; automatic loading for it is off.';
      }else if(action==='auto'){
        const enabled=request.auto;
        if(enabled&&!selected)throw Error('Select a saved profile first.');
        profileStore.setAuto(enabled?selected.id:null,enabled?selected.revision:null);
        if(enabled){
          // Clear the fallback latch only AFTER the requested saved revision was
          // authorized successfully; a stale/failed enable must not erase Stop.
          try{sessionStorage.removeItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP);if(sessionStorage.getItem(PROFILE_SESSION_STOP)==='1')throw Error();}
          catch{try{profileStore.setAuto(null);}catch{}throw Error('Cannot clear the Stop pause in this tab. Automatic loading remains blocked here; check storage before retrying.');}
          profileSessionStopped=false;
        }
        profileNotice=enabled?'Load on startup enabled for '+selected.name+'. Its saved choices, including separately saved network permission, will be requested after reload. F9 pauses this.':'Automatic profile loading is off. Current controls are unchanged.';
      }
    }catch(error){profileNotice=error.message||'Profile action failed. Nothing was loaded.';message(profileNotice);}
    renderProfiles();
  }

# NFSU2 Driving Tools — experimental v0.4.0

A small unpacked Chrome/Edge/Brave extension for **https://nfsu2.xyz/**.

## Install

1. Extract the ZIP to a folder. Keep that folder: the browser loads it from there.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` (Edge: `edge://extensions`).
3. Turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked**, and select the extracted **NFSU2-Driving-Tools** folder containing `manifest.json`.
4. Reload nfsu2.xyz, then press Play. The Driving tools dropdown appears at the upper right. Click it or press F8 to open it.

Chrome 111+ or a current compatible Chromium browser is required. This package is not a mobile-browser or Firefox build. No build command, Node installation or package dependencies are needed to install it.

Car ghosting is intentionally not included; use the game’s own menu for that.

## Dropdown and saved choices

Click **Driving tools** or press **F8** to open/close the dropdown during play. It groups Native driver, Power & speed, Handling, Drag racing and Diagnostics. Every switch can be enabled independently. Tab and Space operate the controls; Escape closes the dropdown without clearing them.

Enabled choices are kept between races, car reloads and normal same-tab page reloads using this site’s session storage. They pause in menus, loading screens, unsupported/network modes, hidden tabs and lost focus. They resume when a supported driving state returns. Power/grip wait for three matching samples before applying to a rebuilt car and never repeatedly multiply their own changes. Closing the tab ends this session’s saved choices; browser restore behavior can vary. If storage is unavailable, choices remain only until the page reloads.

**F7 / Take control** returns the native AI car to your input on the next game frame. Arrow/WASD keys and Space also switch AI off. These key checks use physical keyboard events, not controller axes; controller users should use F7 or the Take control button. Taking control also pauses synthetic drag throttle until its switch is changed again.

**F9 / Stop is the explicit off switch** for AI, NOS, power, limiter removal, grip and drag. Diagnostics and native drift stay under their own switches. Since drag’s enabled choice is kept, it resumes in the next supported solo drag race; disable it first if you don’t want that.

## Try native AI first

1. Replace the old extension folder, reload its card, then reload nfsu2.xyz. Check version **0.4.0**.
2. Start a solo race or move into free roam yourself. Open **Driving tools** or press **F8**.
3. Enable **AI driver · level 9**. Wait for **Native game AI driving · level 9** to confirm the actual driver changed.
4. Press **F7** or **Take control** to return to manual driving. The dropdown can remain open while driving.
5. Start with ordinary power/grip, then try your independent power, NOS and handling switches. Higher power can make native AI crash more often; no win is guaranteed.

Native AI is **off after every page reload**, regardless of saved choices. Within the same page its requested setting can resume after a supported race/car transition. It pauses while unfocused, hidden, in menus or unsupported/network modes. If the page stops updating the command bridge, it gives control back within 180 game frames. A broken/frozen game cannot process a takeover; disable the extension and reload if necessary.

## Switches

- **AI driver · level 9:** hands the player’s car to the game’s own `Player::AutoPilotOn`, then uses `AutoPilotOff` and `SetInputMode(2)` to return control. Uses the highest normal native skill value, **9**, only for your racer; restores your original skill when the same racer still exists. Special skill sentinels are left unchanged and are not reported as level 9. Solo races and free roam only, one local player. Native free-roam driving is backed by upstream game tests, but wandering quality, route selection and obstacle avoidance are not live-verified. This does not select events, enter/restart races, buy upgrades, complete career menus or follow a chosen GPS destination. It can become stuck. "Expert" is not claimed as an official name for numeric skill 9. NOS refill, power, limiter and grip remain independently usable. The separate drag-key assist pauses while native AI is requested/active so two drivers do not fight. Native AI chooses its own nitrous use; refilling does not force it to activate NOS.

- **Unlimited NOS:** repeatedly refills the equipped nitrous kit while driving. It does not install a missing kit or change its capacity. Experimental memory implementation, pinned to game build `6f4f1e4e`. Paused in Online/LAN races. A new game build disables memory tools instead of trying unknown offsets.
- **Engine power boost:** 1.0×–3.0× engine and nitrous torque, with 1.5× as the starting value. This increases power, not the game clock or the speedometer. The original curve is kept, so repeated updates do not multiply power again. More power can cause wheelspin and worse handling. Pause, losing focus, F9 or disabling it restores fields still owned by the extension. If the game rebuilds the tuning, the effect pauses and resumes after the new baseline settles. The selected switch stays enabled.
- **Remove stock speed limiter:** removes the stock MPH governor while enabled. Cars with an ECU upgrade may already have no governor, so this can make no difference. Gearing, redline, drag and available power still limit actual top speed. It does not add gears, change ratios or guarantee a particular speed.
- **Extra grip:** multiplies all four wheels’ actual tyre-force factors by **1.0×–2.0×**, starting at **1.3×**. It can increase cornering traction and reduce sliding, but it does not auto-steer, damp yaw, flatten the car, avoid crashes or guarantee perfect handling. High grip can cause abrupt handling or rollover, especially with extra power. 1.0× restores the baseline. It pauses in drift mode/races because drift deliberately changes rear grip. Changes are restored when paused/off where the original car and wheel objects still exist. No save-file or shared car-type data is edited.
- **Drift assist:** sends the game’s dedicated drift key directly through its version-checked input mailbox, replacing the earlier hidden-touch-control click. This uses the real drift-event handling and your Drift tuning, its built-in drift assist, camera and scoring. The game restores ordinary tuning when disabled. Solo free roam only; close game menus first. It now waits up to three seconds for the game’s actual drift-handling flag before reporting ON, and shows a useful failure message if not confirmed. The game’s mode is unavailable in ordinary races and co-op. Power/limiter/grip effects pause and restore before a drift toggle so the game can rebuild its tuning cleanly; enabled choices are retained. Power can resume afterward, while grip stays paused during drift. **This is not perfect-drift automation and does not guarantee a score, line or spin prevention.**
- **Drag assist:** experimental automatic throttle, RPM-threshold upshifts and NOS when the NOS switch is on. Start a solo drag race yourself. It uses default bindings: Arrow Up, Left Shift, Left Alt. Set the shift RPM to suit the car; 6500 is only a starting point, not a learned perfect-shift value. **You must steer. It does not change lanes, avoid traffic/obstacles, prevent damage or finish races by itself.** It waits for an active driving HUD and pauses in menus, on loss of focus, and when the tab is hidden. Its switch stays enabled; F9 explicitly turns it off. It does not handle race selection or restart.
- **Traffic / barrier tester:** opt-in read-only diagnostic using the game's live car objects and enabled barrier-line table. It reports a nearby car ahead and a barrier crossing the car's forward line. It does not alter driving or send diagnostics anywhere. **It is not a complete obstacle detector:** car objects are not classified as traffic versus racers, parked/inactive objects may appear, and scenery, props, trucks' shapes, road geometry, elevation-sensitive barriers and safe lanes are not comprehensively modeled. “No object detected” never means the road is safe.

The dropdown can stay open while you drive. Its scroll area keeps all controls reachable on smaller screens.

## Testing status and cautions

The site, its public source and exact served game module were inspected. JavaScript syntax checks and **48 automated tests** pass, covering refill logic, missing kits, pause/network guards, invalid/stale pointers, memory growth, read-only hazard extraction, bounded traversal, status-table reading, non-compounding power scaling, guarded restoration drift-input ring formatting/guards, wheel grip restoration, dropdown keyboard/click actions, focus pauses, race/car transitions, rebuild reapplication and same-tab settings restoration. Additional AI tests validate the actual injected WebAssembly bridge with simulated native calls, highest-skill save/restore, correct return-to-input calls, failed-handoff behavior, stale-heartbeat fallback, unsupported/network guards, car replacement and user takeover. The exact served game module passes WebAssembly validation and compilation after the single-function bridge addition. UI tests use a simulated DOM, not live gameplay.

**You reported that NOS and the traffic/barrier tester work. Native AI, new grip/transition behavior, power/limiter controls and the repaired drift path have not been live-verified.** The available test browser cannot run this game's WebGPU graphics, and you asked to test it yourself. These are source-backed experimental implementations, not a promise that all functions work in a live race.

## Updating from an earlier package

Extract this package into your existing extension folder, click Reload on its card in `chrome://extensions`, then reload the game. The card must show version **0.4.0**. If you load a separate new folder, remove/disable the old extension first so two copies cannot run together.

Back up your save with the game's Download backup button before trying it. Use driving modifications in solo play and follow the site's rules. The page's main thread writes shared game memory asynchronously for NOS, power and grip changes, so crashes or inconsistent behavior remain possible. If anything behaves oddly, disable the extension and reload the game. Memory changes do not survive reload; enabled choices are restored from same-tab session storage as described above.

This extension only matches `https://nfsu2.xyz/*`. It has no account, browsing-history, extension-storage, debugger or broad website permissions. It saves only its own switch/number preferences in a namespaced session-storage entry on this site. The only request it creates is a same-origin read of `/game.json` to check compatibility. At game loading, it also inspects the module response the game already fetched, checks its full SHA-256, and adds its own small bridge to the existing game-thread frame hook before compilation. This can add startup time and does not modify the site's files or bypass build checks. The extension package contains no game executable/assets, remote executable code, analytics or update downloader. If the hash or layout is different, it loads the unchanged game and leaves AI disabled.

## Native AI implementation notes

- Supported module revision: `6f4f1e4e`, exact original size `37839055` bytes.
- Required SHA-256: `ee5d281a3109240d5db25dc3921e1044672cf6d650eb58c3baa089b54fe2941f`.
- The bridge runs only at the documented `0x581475` main-loop call of `sub_004022c0`, through the existing CPU-preserving `gcall_main`. It does not invoke game functions concurrently from the page thread or enable the upstream test-script mode.
- A small command/status area at `0x00d0d100` is in the already committed split-screen scratch region, outside the inspected split-screen, minimap-diagnostic and co-op records. Exact-module hashing guards these assumptions.
- Player-car skill path: `Player+4 → vehicle`, `vehicle+0x14 → racer`, `racer+0x901 → skill byte`. The AI driver’s skill virtual getter (`vtable 0x785370 + 0x78 → 0x402580 → 0x610510`) reads this byte. The global force-skill setting is never modified.
- This is experimental client-side code. Keep your v0.3 folder/ZIP for rollback. No game binary is included in this package.

    tunePerformance(s, power = 1, unlimit = false) {

# NFSU2 Driving Tools — experimental v0.6.0

A small unpacked Chrome/Edge/Brave extension for **https://nfsu2.xyz/**.

## Install

1. Extract the ZIP to a folder. Keep that folder: the browser loads it from there.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` (Edge: `edge://extensions`).
3. Turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked**, and select the extracted **NFSU2-Driving-Tools** folder containing `manifest.json`.
4. Reload nfsu2.xyz, then press Play. The Driving tools dropdown appears at the upper right. Click it or press F8 to open it.

Chrome 111+ or a current compatible Chromium browser is required. This package is not a mobile-browser or Firefox build. No build command, Node installation or package dependencies are needed to install it.

Car ghosting is intentionally not included; use the game’s own menu for that.

## Dropdown and saved choices

Click **Driving tools** or press **F8** to open/close the compact dropdown during play. It uses the DFO admin tool’s square green/blue styling, with a narrower **292px** panel. Session mode, Native driver, Power & speed, Handling, Drag racing and Diagnostics start folded; opening one main section closes the previous one. Help text is tucked into optional details. The panel scrolls on small screens, and F7/F9 buttons stay at the top.

Every switch can be enabled independently. AI pace, power, grip and shift RPM use bounded adjustment bars with live numeric values. Tab moves between controls; Space changes switches and arrow keys adjust a focused bar without taking control from AI. Escape closes the dropdown without clearing the choices.

Enabled choices are kept between races, car reloads and normal same-tab page reloads using this site’s session storage. They pause in menus, loading screens, unsupported modes, hidden tabs and lost focus. Online/LAN races pause them unless you enable the separate session opt-in. They resume when a supported driving state returns. Power/grip wait for three matching samples before applying to a rebuilt car and never repeatedly multiply their own changes. Closing the tab ends this session’s saved choices; browser restore behavior can vary. If storage is unavailable, choices remain only until the page reloads.

**F7 / Take control** returns the native AI car to your input on the next game frame. Arrow/WASD keys and Space also switch AI off. These key checks use physical keyboard events, not controller axes; controller users should use F7 or the Take control button. Taking control also pauses synthetic drag throttle until its switch is changed again.

**F9 / Stop is the explicit off switch** for the Online/LAN opt-in, AI, custom AI pace, NOS, power, limiter removal, grip and drag. Diagnostics and native drift stay under their own switches. F9 clears these enabled switches; their selected slider values are retained for later use.

## Opt-in Online/LAN mode

1. Open **Driving tools → Session mode** and read the warning.
2. Turn on **Allow Online/LAN tools** for this page. It starts **OFF after every page reload**, even if it was selected before.
3. Enable the individual tools you want: NOS refill, power, limiter removal, grip, native AI/pace, or drag assistance. The session switch does not enable them by itself; any already-selected compatible tools can resume immediately.
4. **F9 / Stop** disables the session opt-in and driving tools. Turning off only the session switch immediately stops AI and synthetic keys, restores owned power/grip values when the car still exists, and keeps tool selections for solo play. NOS already refilled is not drained on opt-out.

The UI distinguishes selected settings from actual active effects. Online status says **Online/LAN opt-in** or explains that the tools are paused. F7, manual keyboard takeover, focus/visibility pauses, build checks, memory-layout checks and heartbeat fallback still apply.

**Experimental, not live-verified online.** Performance changes can affect other racers, trigger integrity checks, invalidate results or lead to a ban under the server's rules. This option changes only the extension's own Online/LAN guards. It does not change native online flags, networking, server checks, reports, authentication, permissions or access controls, and it provides no detection-avoidance guarantee.

Native drift mode is still free-roam-only because the game itself limits that toggle. Extra grip still pauses in drift. This extension's player-autopilot handoff remains unavailable in drag; its separate drag assist supplies throttle and shifts, and you must steer.

## Try native AI first

1. Replace the old extension folder, reload its card, then reload nfsu2.xyz. Check version **0.6.0**.
2. Start a solo non-drag race or move into free roam yourself. Open **Driving tools** or press **F8**, then expand **Native driver**.
3. Enable **AI driver · level 9**. Wait for **Native game AI driving · level 9** to confirm the actual driver changed.
4. Press **F7** or **Take control** to return to manual driving. The dropdown can remain open while driving.
5. Start with ordinary power/grip, then try your independent power, NOS and handling switches. Higher power can make native AI crash more often; no win is guaranteed.
6. To experiment with its target speed, enable **Custom AI pace** and adjust **AI pace factor**. Start at **1.00×**. A higher factor may worsen cornering and cause crashes; a lower factor is not a cornering fix. The switch does not enable the AI driver by itself.

Native AI is **off after every page reload**, regardless of saved choices. Within the same page its requested setting can resume after a supported race/car transition. It pauses while unfocused, hidden, in menus or unsupported modes; Online/LAN requires the session opt-in. If the page stops updating the command bridge, it gives control back within 180 game frames. A broken/frozen game cannot process a takeover; disable the extension and reload if necessary.

## Switches

- **AI driver · level 9:** hands the player’s car to the game’s own `Player::AutoPilotOn`, then uses `AutoPilotOff` and `SetInputMode(2)` to return control. Uses the highest normal native skill value, **9**, only for your racer; restores your original skill when the same racer still exists. Special skill sentinels are left unchanged and are not reported as level 9. Non-drag races and free roam, one local player. Online/LAN requires the session opt-in and has not been live-verified. Native free-roam driving is backed by upstream game tests, but route selection and obstacle avoidance are not guaranteed. This does not select events, enter/restart races, buy upgrades, complete career menus or follow a chosen GPS destination. It can become stuck. "Expert" is not claimed as an official name for numeric skill 9. NOS refill, power, limiter and grip remain independently usable. This extension’s player-autopilot handoff is suspended in drag races because that handoff has not been verified there. This does not mean the game lacks drag-opponent AI. If you separately enable drag assist, it waits for native AI to release ownership and for the car’s human driver to be confirmed before sending throttle or shift keys. Native AI chooses its own nitrous use; refilling does not force it to activate NOS.

- **Custom AI pace:** opt-in **0.75×–1.50×** adjustment of the native AI’s freshly calculated target-speed factor, with **1.00×** as the unchanged default. This is not an actual-speed multiplier, an engine-power change or improved steering. Higher values can make corners worse and cause crashes; lower values do not guarantee safe cornering. Applies only while this extension’s native AI is driving. The status distinguishes a selected/requested factor from a factor confirmed by the game hook. The pace choice and value are saved in the same tab, but AI itself still starts off after reload. F7 stops AI while leaving the pace choice dormant; F9 also clears the pace switch. Existing power, grip and NOS controls remain independent.

- **Unlimited NOS:** repeatedly refills the equipped nitrous kit while driving. It does not install a missing kit or change its capacity. Experimental memory implementation, pinned to game build `6f4f1e4e`. Paused in Online/LAN races unless the session opt-in is on. A new game build disables memory tools instead of trying unknown offsets.
- **Engine power boost:** 1.0×–3.0× engine and nitrous torque, with 1.5× as the starting value. This increases power, not the game clock or the speedometer. The original curve is kept, so repeated updates do not multiply power again. More power can cause wheelspin and worse handling. Pause, losing focus, F9 or disabling it restores fields still owned by the extension. If the game rebuilds the tuning, the effect pauses and resumes after the new baseline settles. The selected switch stays enabled.
- **Remove stock speed limiter:** removes the stock MPH governor while enabled. Cars with an ECU upgrade may already have no governor, so this can make no difference. Gearing, redline, drag and available power still limit actual top speed. It does not add gears, change ratios or guarantee a particular speed.
- **Extra grip:** multiplies all four wheels’ actual tyre-force factors by **1.0×–2.0×**, starting at **1.3×**. It can increase cornering traction and reduce sliding, but it does not auto-steer, damp yaw, flatten the car, avoid crashes or guarantee perfect handling. High grip can cause abrupt handling or rollover, especially with extra power. 1.0× restores the baseline. It pauses in drift mode/races because drift deliberately changes rear grip. Changes are restored when paused/off where the original car and wheel objects still exist. No save-file or shared car-type data is edited.
- **Drift assist:** sends the game’s dedicated drift key directly through its version-checked input mailbox, replacing the earlier hidden-touch-control click. This uses the real drift-event handling and your Drift tuning, its built-in drift assist, camera and scoring. The game restores ordinary tuning when disabled. Solo free roam only; close game menus first. It now waits up to three seconds for the game’s actual drift-handling flag before reporting ON, and shows a useful failure message if not confirmed. The game’s mode is unavailable in ordinary races and co-op. Power/limiter/grip effects pause and restore before a drift toggle so the game can rebuild its tuning cleanly; enabled choices are retained. Power can resume afterward, while grip stays paused during drift. **This is not perfect-drift automation and does not guarantee a score, line or spin prevention.**
- **Drag assist:** experimental automatic throttle, RPM-threshold upshifts and NOS when the NOS switch is on. Start a drag race yourself and enable this separate switch; Online/LAN also needs its session opt-in. The native player-autopilot handoff is not verified for drag. Throttle can pre-rev during the countdown once the driving HUD is active. Shifts and NOS wait until racing begins. It uses default bindings: Arrow Up, Left Shift, Left Alt. Set the shift RPM to suit the car; 6500 is only a starting point, not a learned perfect-shift value. **You must steer. It does not change lanes, avoid traffic/obstacles, prevent damage or finish races by itself.** Steering during drag does not disable this assist just because the native-AI switch remains selected for other races. F7 pauses assisted throttle until you toggle drag assist again. It pauses in menus, on loss of focus, and when the tab is hidden. Its switch stays enabled; F9 explicitly turns it off. It does not handle race selection or restart.
- **Traffic / barrier tester:** opt-in read-only diagnostic using the game's live car objects and enabled barrier-line table. It reports a nearby car ahead and a barrier crossing the car's forward line. It does not alter driving or send diagnostics anywhere. **It is not a complete obstacle detector:** car objects are not classified as traffic versus racers, parked/inactive objects may appear, and scenery, props, trucks' shapes, road geometry, elevation-sensitive barriers and safe lanes are not comprehensively modeled. “No object detected” never means the road is safe.

The dropdown can stay open while you drive. Its scroll area keeps all controls reachable on smaller screens.

## Testing status and cautions

The site, its public source and exact served game module were inspected. All 77 v0.6 automated tests passed. The suite includes opt-in/off behavior for every network flag, native AI/pace permission forwarding, opt-out restoration, session-reset behavior, manual stop and online drag key release. Automated tests cover refill logic, missing kits, pause/network guards, invalid/stale pointers, memory growth, read-only hazard extraction, bounded traversal, status-table reading, non-compounding power scaling, guarded restoration drift-input ring formatting/guards, wheel grip restoration, dropdown keyboard/click actions, focus pauses, race/car transitions, rebuild reapplication and same-tab settings restoration. UI tests also cover slider bounds, numeric outputs, opt-in pace forwarding, saved pace choices, F7/F9 behavior and keyboard use within the menu. Additional AI tests validate the actual injected WebAssembly bridge with simulated native calls, highest-skill save/restore, correct return-to-input calls, failed-handoff behavior, stale-heartbeat fallback, unsupported/network guards, car replacement and user takeover. UI tests use a simulated DOM, not live gameplay.

**You reported that NOS and the traffic/barrier tester work, and that native AI drives in free roam but cuts corners and is slow. In drag, it applied throttle and then stopped. The new pace adjustment and drag-routing/countdown fixes have not been live-verified.** New grip/transition behavior, power/limiter controls and the repaired drift path also remain experimental. Pace adjustment is not a verified cornering improvement. These are source-backed experimental implementations, not a promise that all functions work in a live race.

## Updating from an earlier package

Extract this package into your existing extension folder, click Reload on its card in `chrome://extensions`, then reload the game. The card must show version **0.6.0**. If you load a separate new folder, remove/disable the old extension first so two copies cannot run together.

Back up your save with the game's Download backup button before trying it. Follow the site's rules; Online/LAN modifications can affect other racers and trigger integrity checks or moderation. Prefer solo play or an explicitly permitted private test. The page's main thread writes shared game memory asynchronously for NOS, power and grip changes, so crashes or inconsistent behavior remain possible. If anything behaves oddly, disable the extension and reload the game. Memory changes do not survive reload; enabled choices are restored from same-tab session storage as described above.

This extension only matches `https://nfsu2.xyz/*`. It has no account, browsing-history, extension-storage, debugger or broad website permissions. It saves only its own switch/number preferences in a namespaced session-storage entry on this site. The only request it creates is a same-origin read of `/game.json` to check compatibility. At game loading, it also inspects the module response the game already fetched, checks its full SHA-256, and adds its own main-loop handoff bridge and player-only AI target-speed hook before compilation. This can add startup time and does not modify the site's files or bypass build checks. The extension package contains no game executable/assets, remote executable code, analytics or update downloader. If the hash or layout is different, it loads the unchanged game and leaves AI disabled.

## Native AI implementation notes

- Supported module revision: `6f4f1e4e`, exact original size `37839055` bytes.
- Required SHA-256: `ee5d281a3109240d5db25dc3921e1044672cf6d650eb58c3baa089b54fe2941f`.
- The handoff bridge runs only at the documented `0x581475` main-loop call of `sub_004022c0`, through the existing CPU-preserving `gcall_main`. It does not invoke game functions concurrently from the page thread or enable the upstream test-script mode.
- The pace hook preserves the port’s `sub_004172d0` wrapper: save the original driver, call `sub_004172d0_orig`, then call `catchup_apply`. Only afterward, for this extension’s still-owned player driver, it multiplies the freshly computed `driver+0x770` target-speed factor by 0.75–1.50. At 1.00 it leaves the field unchanged. Native recomputation prevents compounding. It does not alter `vehicle+0x468` (native power/grip catchup), steering, road paths or other AI cars. Its layout is confirmed by `vehicle+0x2c → driver` and `driver+4 → vehicle`.
- Both game-thread hooks reject the drag-race byte at `0x89e7d8`. Entering drag releases an owned AI driver through the same native Off/SetInputMode calls. The separate page drag assist waits for driver type 1 and cleared AI ownership.
- The page publishes its explicit Online/LAN opt-in as command word `+84`, under the same sequence lock as the other commands. Both native hooks require the exact value `1` to allow network state; other state/layout/ownership checks stay intact. Stop clears that word. The revised handshake rejects older command layouts.
- The exact served module passes validation and compilation after the two-function patch. Tests verify that all other function bodies and module sections remain byte-for-byte unchanged. These are code-level checks, not live gameplay validation.
- An 88-byte command/status area at `0x00d0d100` is in the already committed split-screen scratch region, outside the inspected split-screen, minimap-diagnostic and co-op records. Exact-module hashing guards these assumptions.
- Player-car skill path: `Player+4 → vehicle`, `vehicle+0x14 → racer`, `racer+0x901 → skill byte`. The AI driver’s skill virtual getter (`vtable 0x785370 + 0x78 → 0x402580 → 0x610510`) reads this byte. The global force-skill setting is never modified.
- This is experimental client-side code. Keep your working v0.5 folder/ZIP for rollback. No game binary is included in this package.

# NFSU2 source and unfinished-work handoff

This is a development source handoff, not a new extension release or installation. Extract the ZIP to a short writable local path, then open this `nfsu2-extension` folder in Codex. The original cloud source was `/workspace/scratch/0d6b822176fd/nfsu2-extension`; that path is not automatically available on a different computer. Work from the extracted folder.

## Start here

- `combined-v033-integration/`: frozen v0.33.0 baseline. Full extension source, test files, authored test WASM, tools, integration documents and verification records are included.
- `research/race-geometry-capture/`: route geometry research and its isolated recording candidate. Read `candidate/README.md` and `candidate/extension/RACE-CAPTURE.md`. This is not a complete map or proven all-corners solution.
- `tuner-s42-window-candidate/`: isolated S42 high-guest-window compatibility candidate. Read `integration/tuner-s42-window/HANDOFF.md` and `research/tuner-s42-proof/FINDINGS.md`. Independent review and live S42 retest remain outstanding in the copied handoff.
- `drift-line-telemetry-v034-candidate/`: reviewed read-only diagnostic additions. Read `integration/drift-line/HANDOFF.md`. It is not a driving fix.
- `owned-navigation-v034-work/`: most recent owned-navigation development tree. Begin with `integration/TRAVEL-WORK-IN-PROGRESS.md`, `integration/NAVIGATION-ABI.md`, `integration/DESTINATION-PROOF.md` and the source/tests. Earlier copied handoffs describe earlier checkpoints and are not authoritative over newer source or evidence.
- `hosted-city-v034-candidate/`, `hosted-full-v033-candidate/`, `hosted-travel-v033-candidate/`, `hosted-events-v033-candidate/`, `hosted-race-selector-prototype/`, `autonomous-races-candidate/`: separate experimental checkpoints, not one merged release. Some intentionally retain 0.32.0 or 0.33.0 labels. Do not overwrite the v0.33 baseline or combine candidates blindly.
- `research/`: route/GPS/parking/topology fixtures, event-catalog evidence, tuner proof notes, drift findings and historical handoffs.
- `fixed-folder-updates/`: established desktop-folder update tooling and instructions.

## Portable setup and test limits

Node.js and Python 3 are required. The original WABT dependency was `wabt@1.0.39`; third-party dependency folders are excluded. Some build scripts support `WABT_MODULE`. Others expect the package in `research/compatibility-v011/node_modules/wabt` relative to their project. Install dependencies locally only when needed, for example from the extracted root:

    npm install --prefix research/compatibility-v011 wabt@1.0.39
    python prepare-research.py combined-v033-integration

The original projects used a `research -> ../research` link. Links are excluded for Windows portability. `prepare-research.py PROJECT` copies the curated research folder into one selected project without replacing existing files. This may copy the installed WABT dependency too. Use a short extraction path if Windows path limits apply.

From the baseline folder, a useful self-contained smoke test is:

    node --test tests/core.test.cjs tests/package-release.test.cjs

All test sources are provided, but the complete native test suite cannot run from this ZIP alone. Exact-native tests and some builders require original game modules, native extracts or other artifacts intentionally omitted. Old absolute paths in research scripts/reproduction logs must be reviewed and redirected to local inputs. Historical pass counts describe their original run, not a fresh run on your computer.

## Scope and integrity

No original full game WASM, game asset/data files, raw native research extracts, credentials, dependency folders, screenshots, copied upstream checkout, caches or old release ZIPs are included. Authored hook bodies and small authored test fixtures are retained so the extension sources are complete. Selected research evidence includes metadata/inventories, not game assets. Large generated logs and duplicate historical integration outputs in candidates are omitted. The full shared research directory was approximately 3.8 GB and was deliberately not copied.

`SOURCE-MANIFEST.json` lists SHA-256 and size for every copied source file. Handoff-only README/setup/manifest files are additional. Source files were copied without editing. Packaging did not change live source, install anything, contact a game server, join a race, test a live finish/win, or establish saved-game persistence. Offline/synthetic results must not be described as live proof. Review each candidate and preserve existing features before merging or shipping.

# v0.30.0 · Compact read-only info HUD

- Adds a compact, click-through HUD below the closed launcher. F6 or the Info HUD switch toggles display; this same-tab choice is separate from saved driving profiles. The full menu temporarily hides the card.
- Shows guarded native speed in km/h, AI/manual driver state, current pace request versus matching native acknowledgement, and requested power versus observed field application. Missing telemetry is Unavailable, never a fabricated zero. Pace and power factors do not represent a measured speed gain.
- Clears current evidence on interruption, game/session replacement and control changes. A past acknowledgement cannot confirm a newly selected pace value. No controller, physics, native payload, game-save, permission or tuner behavior changed.
- Combined suite: **1,788 passed, zero failures/skips/cancellations**, including 20 focused HUD checks and read-only memory assertions. Strict-CSP browser fixture is prepared but blocked before page load by process socket restrictions, including the elevated retry. Live game appearance and driving remain unverified.

# v0.15.0 · Native opponent AI paths

## Changes on exact build 78e2bb69 only

Status confirms id and vtable; pending is not success.
- **Native drift physics:** corrects normal unmarked player drift events to driver 3/physics 1 through the native setter, preserving drag-first mode precedence. Invalid driver state or failed correction rolls back to manual control. Existing mode/identity/heartbeat/network guards and full event handback remain.
- **Native nitrous decisions:** permits the owned player to reach native request/cancellation logic for recognized drag goal 2, observed road goal 1 in actual race types 1/7, and observed chase goal 5 only in Outrun 7. It never selects chase goal 5 or enables this new path in free roam 0. Native tactical/skill/availability/resource conditions remain intact; no refill or forced activation is added. The separate Unlimited NOS control remains unchanged.
- Cancellation uses the same authorized owned race scope without a new-start goal requirement, so recovery/NULL goal transitions cannot suppress native cancellation. New starts remain strictly goal-gated.

Native full allocator/configuration and cancellation execution, plus the complete skill/resource graph, remain unverified.
